
��define("game.js", (function(require, module, exports, process){ 
/* 亮车计划 · 微信小游戏入口（构建生成，不要手改） */ /* =====================================================================
 * 微信小游戏适配层
 * 把游戏用到的浏览器 API（document / canvas / pointer / storage / audio）
 * 映射到 wx.*。只"补装"当前环境缺失的全局，已有的不动。
 * =================================================================== */ (function() {
    "use strict";
    var info = wx.getSystemInfoSync();
    var SW = info.screenWidth || 375;
    var SH = info.screenHeight || 667;
    var DPR = Math.min(info.pixelRatio || 1, 2);
    var G = typeof GameGlobal !== "undefined" ? GameGlobal : this;
    function install(name, value) {
        if (typeof G[name] !== "undefined") return;
        try {
            G[name] = value;
        } catch (e) {}
    }
    /* ---------------- 主画布 ---------------- */ var mainCanvas = wx.createCanvas();
    mainCanvas.width = Math.round(SW * DPR);
    mainCanvas.height = Math.round(SH * DPR);
    mainCanvas.style = {
        width: SW + "px",
        height: SH + "px"
    };
    mainCanvas.getBoundingClientRect = function() {
        return {
            left: 0,
            top: 0,
            width: SW,
            height: SH,
            right: SW,
            bottom: SH
        };
    };
    var stageEl = {
        style: {},
        getBoundingClientRect: function getBoundingClientRect() {
            return {
                left: 0,
                top: 0,
                width: SW,
                height: SH,
                right: SW,
                bottom: SH
            };
        }
    };
    /* ---------------- 触摸 → pointer ---------------- */ var handlers = {
        down: [],
        move: [],
        up: []
    };
    function emit(kind, e) {
        var t = e.touches && e.touches[0] || e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0];
        if (!t) return;
        var ev = {
            clientX: t.clientX,
            clientY: t.clientY,
            pointerId: t.identifier != null ? t.identifier : 1,
            pointerType: "touch",
            isPrimary: true,
            preventDefault: function preventDefault() {},
            stopPropagation: function stopPropagation() {}
        };
        var list = handlers[kind];
        for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
            try {
                list[i](ev);
            } catch (err) {}
        }
    }
    wx.onTouchStart(function(e) {
        emit("down", e);
    });
    wx.onTouchMove(function(e) {
        emit("move", e);
    });
    wx.onTouchEnd(function(e) {
        emit("up", e);
    });
    wx.onTouchCancel(function(e) {
        emit("up", e);
    });
    // 实例级覆盖：即使底层是 DOM canvas，也走 wx 触摸通道
    mainCanvas.addEventListener = function(type, fn) {
        if (type === "pointerdown") handlers.down.push(fn);
        else if (type === "pointermove") handlers.move.push(fn);
        else handlers.up.push(fn);
    };
    mainCanvas.removeEventListener = function() {};
    mainCanvas.setPointerCapture = function() {};
    mainCanvas.releasePointerCapture = function() {};
    /* ---------------- document ---------------- */ var docEl = {
        hidden: false,
        getElementById: function getElementById(id) {
            if (id === "game") return mainCanvas;
            if (id === "stage") return stageEl;
            return null;
        },
        createElement: function createElement(tag) {
            if (tag === "canvas") {
                var c = wx.createCanvas(); // 第二次以后调用拿到的是离屏画布
                c.style = {};
                return c;
            }
            return {
                style: {},
                appendChild: function appendChild() {},
                setAttribute: function setAttribute() {}
            };
        },
        addEventListener: function addEventListener(type, fn) {
            if (type === "visibilitychange") {
                wx.onHide(function() {
                    docEl.hidden = true;
                    try {
                        fn();
                    } catch (e) {}
                });
                wx.onShow(function() {
                    docEl.hidden = false;
                    try {
                        fn();
                    } catch (e) {}
                });
            }
        },
        removeEventListener: function removeEventListener() {},
        body: {
            style: {},
            appendChild: function appendChild() {}
        }
    };
    /* ---------------- 全局 ---------------- */ install("document", docEl);
    install("location", {
        search: "",
        href: "minigame:///",
        origin: ""
    });
    install("innerWidth", SW);
    install("innerHeight", SH);
    install("devicePixelRatio", DPR);
    install("addEventListener", function() {});
    install("removeEventListener", function() {});
    /* ---------------- 存储 ---------------- */ install("localStorage", {
        getItem: function getItem(k) {
            try {
                var v = wx.getStorageSync(k);
                return v === "" || v === undefined || v === null ? null : v;
            } catch (e) {
                return null;
            }
        },
        setItem: function setItem(k, v) {
            try {
                wx.setStorageSync(k, String(v));
            } catch (e) {}
        },
        removeItem: function removeItem(k) {
            try {
                wx.removeStorageSync(k);
            } catch (e) {}
        }
    });
    /* ---------------- 震动 ---------------- */ function shortVibe(strong) {
        try {
            wx.vibrateShort({
                type: strong ? "medium" : "light",
                fail: function fail() {}
            });
        } catch (e) {}
    }
    install("navigator", {
        userAgent: "minigame",
        vibrate: function vibrate1(pattern) {
            if (typeof pattern === "number") {
                shortVibe(pattern > 20);
                return true;
            }
            if (Object.prototype.toString.call(pattern) === "[object Array]" && pattern.length) {
                var strong = false, j, t = 0;
                for(j = 1; j < pattern.length; j += 2)if (pattern[j] > 20) strong = true;
                for(j = 1; j < pattern.length && j < 9; j += 2){
                    t += (pattern[j - 1] || 0) + 30;
                    (function(delay, st) {
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            shortVibe(st);
                        }, delay);
                    })(t, strong);
                }
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    });
    /* ---------------- 时间 / 动画帧 ---------------- */ if (typeof G.performance === "undefined") {
        G.performance = {
            now: function now() {
                return Date.now();
            }
        };
    }
    if (typeof G.requestAnimationFrame === "undefined") {
        G.requestAnimationFrame = function(cb) {
            return setTimeout(function() {
                cb(Date.now());
            }, 16);
        };
    }
    if (typeof G.URLSearchParams === "undefined") {
        // 真正解析一遍，别做成永远返回 false 的空壳 —— 否则 ?debug / ?mute 全部失效
        G.URLSearchParams = function(search) {
            var map = {};
            var s = String(search == null ? "" : search).replace(/^\?/, "");
            if (s) {
                var parts = s.split("&");
                for(var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++){
                    if (!parts[i]) continue;
                    var kv = parts[i].split("=");
                    var k = decodeURIComponent(kv[0] || "");
                    var v = decodeURIComponent(kv.slice(1).join("=") || "");
                    map[k] = v;
                }
            }
            this.has = function(k) {
                return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, k);
            };
            this.get = function(k) {
                return this.has(k) ? map[k] : null;
            };
            this.append = function(k, v) {
                map[k] = String(v);
            };
        };
    }
    /* ---------------- 图片 ---------------- */ // 游戏里的 loadImages 已被构建脚本改写成 wx.createImage()
    install("Image", function() {
        return wx.createImage();
    });
    /* ---------------- 音频 ---------------- */ // 小游戏基础库 2.19.0+ 才有 WebAudio；不支持时游戏自动静音
    try {
        if (typeof G.AudioContext === "undefined" && wx.createWebAudioContext) {
            G.AudioContext = function() {
                return wx.createWebAudioContext();
            };
        }
    } catch (e) {}
    /* ---------------- 刘海屏安全区 ---------------- */ try {
        G.__SAFE_TOP = info.safeArea && info.safeArea.top || info.statusBarHeight || 0;
    } catch (e) {
        G.__SAFE_TOP = 0;
    }
    /* ---------------- 导出给入口包装函数 ---------------- */ // 小游戏全局里可能已有一个残缺的 document（没有 getElementById），
    // 所以不依赖全局解析，改为由构建时包一层函数把这两个对象注入进去。
    try {
        G.__DOC__ = docEl;
        G.__WIN__ = G;
    } catch (e) {}
    /* ---------------- 调试信息 ---------------- */ try {
        G.__WX_ENV = {
            screenWidth: SW,
            screenHeight: SH,
            pixelRatio: DPR,
            safeArea: info.safeArea || null,
            statusBarHeight: info.statusBarHeight || 0
        };
    } catch (e) {}
})();
(function(document, window) {
    /* 素材映射（构建生成） */ window.CW_IMG = {
        bg_dawn: "images/bg_dawn.webp",
        bg_dusk: "images/bg_dusk.webp",
        bg_outdoor: "images/bg_outdoor.webp",
        brick_wall: "images/brick_wall.webp",
        car_black: "images/car_black.webp",
        car_coupe: "images/car_coupe.webp",
        car_jeep: "images/car_jeep.webp",
        car_sedan: "images/car_sedan.webp",
        car_truck: "images/car_truck.webp",
        car_van: "images/car_van.webp",
        dirt_heavy: "images/dirt_heavy.webp",
        dirt_soft: "images/dirt_soft.webp",
        fx_foam: "images/fx_foam.webp",
        fx_splash: "images/fx_splash.webp",
        grime_hard: "images/grime_hard.webp",
        hub: "images/hub.webp",
        paint_damage: "images/paint_damage.webp",
        vase: "images/vase.webp",
        window: "images/window.webp"
    };
    /* =====================================================================
 * 关卡数据 + 升级表
 * 每个关卡 = 一个剪影 + 一个绘制函数 + 一组污渍配方
 * 换新关卡只需要在这里加一坨数据
 * =================================================================== */ (function(root) {
        "use strict";
        var NS = root.CW = root.CW || {};
        var TAU = Math.PI * 2;
        /* ---------- 画布小工具 ---------- */ function rr(c, x, y, w, h, r) {
            r = Math.max(0, Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2));
            c.moveTo(x + r, y);
            c.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
            c.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
            c.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
            c.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
            c.closePath();
        }
        function polyPath(c, pts) {
            c.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
            for(var i = 1; i < pts.length; i++)c.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
            c.closePath();
        }
        function mapPts(pts, x, y, w, h) {
            var out = [];
            for(var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++)out.push([
                x + w * pts[i][0],
                y + h * pts[i][1]
            ]);
            return out;
        }
        function polyBBox(pts) {
            var x0 = 1e9, y0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y1 = -1e9;
            for(var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++){
                x0 = Math.min(x0, pts[i][0]);
                x1 = Math.max(x1, pts[i][0]);
                y0 = Math.min(y0, pts[i][1]);
                y1 = Math.max(y1, pts[i][1]);
            }
            return {
                x0: x0,
                y0: y0,
                x1: x1,
                y1: y1
            };
        }
        /** 朝中心收缩，用来从车厢轮廓得到玻璃轮廓 */ function insetPoly(pts, kx, ky) {
            var b = polyBBox(pts);
            var cx = (b.x0 + b.x1) / 2, cy = (b.y0 + b.y1) / 2;
            var out = [];
            for(var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++){
                out.push([
                    cx + (pts[i][0] - cx) * kx,
                    cy + (pts[i][1] - cy) * ky
                ]);
            }
            return out;
        }
        function lighten(hex, k) {
            var n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
            var r = Math.min(255, Math.round((n >> 16 & 255) * k));
            var g = Math.min(255, Math.round((n >> 8 & 255) * k));
            var b = Math.min(255, Math.round((n & 255) * k));
            return "rgb(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + ")";
        }
        /* ---------- 车辆：一套参数画所有车 ---------- */ function vehicleSilhouette(c, b, s) {
            var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h;
            rr(c, x, y + h * s.bodyTop, w, h * (s.bodyBottom - s.bodyTop), h * s.bodyR);
            polyPath(c, mapPts(s.cabin, x, y, w, h));
            for(var i = 0; i < s.wheels.length; i++){
                var cx = x + w * s.wheels[i], cy = y + h * (1 - s.wheelR), rad = h * s.wheelR;
                c.moveTo(cx + rad, cy);
                c.arc(cx, cy, rad, 0, TAU);
            }
        }
        function vehiclePaint(c, b, s) {
            var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h, i;
            var bt = y + h * s.bodyTop, bb = y + h * s.bodyBottom, bh = bb - bt;
            // 接地阴影：用径向渐变，比一块平椭圆柔和很多
            c.save();
            var sh = c.createRadialGradient(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99, 0, x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99, w * 0.52);
            sh.addColorStop(0, "rgba(16,38,26,0.30)");
            sh.addColorStop(0.62, "rgba(16,38,26,0.14)");
            sh.addColorStop(1, "rgba(16,38,26,0)");
            c.fillStyle = sh;
            c.beginPath();
            c.ellipse(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99, w * 0.52, h * 0.085, 0, 0, TAU);
            c.fill();
            c.restore();
            for(i = 0; i < s.wheels.length; i++){
                var cx = x + w * s.wheels[i], cy = y + h - h * s.wheelR, rad = h * s.wheelR;
                c.beginPath();
                c.arc(cx, cy, rad, 0, TAU);
                c.fillStyle = "#2a2f37";
                c.fill();
                // 胎侧高光
                c.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.10)";
                c.lineWidth = rad * 0.16;
                c.beginPath();
                c.arc(cx, cy, rad * 0.84, Math.PI * 1.12, Math.PI * 1.72);
                c.stroke();
                c.beginPath();
                c.arc(cx, cy, rad * 0.46, 0, TAU);
                c.fillStyle = "#cfd9e4";
                c.fill();
                c.beginPath();
                c.arc(cx, cy, rad * 0.16, 0, TAU);
                c.fillStyle = "#95a3b1";
                c.fill();
            }
            var g = c.createLinearGradient(0, bt, 0, bb);
            g.addColorStop(0, lighten(s.color, 1.14));
            g.addColorStop(0.45, s.color);
            g.addColorStop(1, s.color2);
            c.beginPath();
            rr(c, x, bt, w, bh, h * s.bodyR);
            c.fillStyle = g;
            c.fill();
            // 车身上沿的高光带：一下就有"车漆"的质感
            c.save();
            c.beginPath();
            rr(c, x, bt, w, bh, h * s.bodyR);
            c.clip();
            var hl = c.createLinearGradient(0, bt, 0, bt + bh * 0.34);
            hl.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.40)");
            hl.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
            c.fillStyle = hl;
            c.fillRect(x, bt, w, bh * 0.34);
            c.restore();
            var cabPts = mapPts(s.cabin, x, y, w, h);
            c.beginPath();
            polyPath(c, cabPts);
            var g2 = c.createLinearGradient(0, y + h * s.bodyTop * 0.1, 0, bt);
            g2.addColorStop(0, lighten(s.color, 1.08));
            g2.addColorStop(1, s.color);
            c.fillStyle = g2;
            c.fill();
            var glassN = insetPoly(s.cabin, 0.93, 0.74);
            var glassPts = mapPts(glassN, x, y, w, h);
            var gb = polyBBox(glassN);
            c.beginPath();
            polyPath(c, glassPts);
            var gg = c.createLinearGradient(0, y + h * gb.y0, 0, y + h * gb.y1);
            gg.addColorStop(0, "#D9EEFF");
            gg.addColorStop(0.5, "#A6CDF0");
            gg.addColorStop(1, "#7FB3E2");
            c.fillStyle = gg;
            c.fill();
            c.save();
            c.beginPath();
            polyPath(c, glassPts);
            c.clip();
            c.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.30)";
            c.lineWidth = h * 0.022;
            c.beginPath();
            c.moveTo(x + w * 0.32, y + h * (gb.y1 + 0.01));
            c.lineTo(x + w * 0.38, y + h * (gb.y0 - 0.01));
            c.stroke();
            c.beginPath();
            c.moveTo(x + w * 0.60, y + h * (gb.y1 + 0.01));
            c.lineTo(x + w * 0.66, y + h * (gb.y0 - 0.01));
            c.stroke();
            c.restore();
            var pil = s.pillars || [];
            for(i = 0; i < pil.length; i++){
                var px = x + w * (gb.x0 + (gb.x1 - gb.x0) * pil[i]);
                c.fillStyle = s.color2;
                c.fillRect(px - w * 0.017, y + h * gb.y0, w * 0.034, h * (gb.y1 - gb.y0));
            }
            if (s.headlight !== false) {
                c.beginPath();
                rr(c, x + w * 0.895, bt + bh * 0.28, w * 0.055, bh * 0.26, h * 0.025);
                c.fillStyle = "#ffeec2";
                c.fill();
            }
            if (s.stripe) {
                c.save();
                c.beginPath();
                rr(c, x, bt, w, bh, h * s.bodyR);
                c.clip();
                c.fillStyle = s.stripe;
                c.fillRect(x, bt + bh * 0.52, w, bh * 0.16);
                c.restore();
            }
            if (s.line !== false) {
                c.beginPath();
                c.moveTo(x + w * 0.06, bt + bh * 0.66);
                c.lineTo(x + w * 0.94, bt + bh * 0.66);
                c.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.32)";
                c.lineWidth = Math.max(1, h * 0.012);
                c.stroke();
            }
            c.save();
            c.beginPath();
            rr(c, x, bt, w, bh, h * s.bodyR);
            c.clip();
            c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.13)";
            c.fillRect(x, bb - bh * 0.16, w, bh * 0.16);
            c.restore();
            if (s.rack) {
                c.strokeStyle = "#3d4652";
                c.lineWidth = Math.max(2, h * 0.018);
                c.beginPath();
                c.moveTo(x + w * 0.22, y + h * 0.035);
                c.lineTo(x + w * 0.74, y + h * 0.035);
                c.stroke();
                c.beginPath();
                c.moveTo(x + w * 0.30, y + h * 0.035);
                c.lineTo(x + w * 0.30, y + h * 0.075);
                c.moveTo(x + w * 0.66, y + h * 0.035);
                c.lineTo(x + w * 0.66, y + h * 0.075);
                c.stroke();
            }
        }
        function vehicle(s) {
            return {
                silhouette: function silhouette(c, b) {
                    vehicleSilhouette(c, b, s);
                },
                paint: function paint(c, b) {
                    vehiclePaint(c, b, s);
                }
            };
        }
        /* ---------- 砖墙 ---------- */ function brickWall() {
            return {
                silhouette: function silhouette(c, b) {
                    rr(c, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 8);
                },
                paint: function paint(c, b) {
                    var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h;
                    c.save();
                    c.beginPath();
                    rr(c, x, y, w, h, 8);
                    c.clip();
                    c.fillStyle = "#efe0c8";
                    c.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
                    var rows = 8, cols = 5;
                    var bh = h / rows, bw = w / cols;
                    for(var r = 0; r < rows; r++){
                        var off = r % 2 ? -bw / 2 : 0;
                        for(var i = -1; i <= cols; i++){
                            var bx = x + i * bw + off + 2;
                            var by = y + r * bh + 2;
                            var v = 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.1;
                            c.fillStyle = "rgb(" + (212 * v | 0) + "," + (178 * v | 0) + "," + (146 * v | 0) + ")";
                            c.beginPath();
                            rr(c, bx, by, bw - 4, bh - 4, 3);
                            c.fill();
                        }
                    }
                    c.restore();
                    c.strokeStyle = "rgba(150,118,88,0.55)";
                    c.lineWidth = 2;
                    c.beginPath();
                    rr(c, x, y, w, h, 8);
                    c.stroke();
                }
            };
        }
        /* ---------- 陶罐 ---------- */ var VASE = {
            silhouette: function silhouette(c, b) {
                var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h;
                c.moveTo(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.16);
                c.bezierCurveTo(x - w * 0.05, y + h * 0.26, x + w * 0.02, y + h * 0.92, x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99);
                c.bezierCurveTo(x + w * 0.98, y + h * 0.92, x + w * 1.05, y + h * 0.26, x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.16);
                c.closePath();
                c.moveTo(x + w * 0.33, y + h * 0.055);
                c.lineTo(x + w * 0.67, y + h * 0.055);
                c.lineTo(x + w * 0.60, y + h * 0.20);
                c.lineTo(x + w * 0.40, y + h * 0.20);
                c.closePath();
            },
            paint: function paint(c, b) {
                var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h;
                c.save();
                c.globalAlpha = 0.15;
                c.fillStyle = "#1d3346";
                c.beginPath();
                c.ellipse(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99, w * 0.38, h * 0.04, 0, 0, TAU);
                c.fill();
                c.restore();
                c.beginPath();
                c.moveTo(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.16);
                c.bezierCurveTo(x - w * 0.05, y + h * 0.26, x + w * 0.02, y + h * 0.92, x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99);
                c.bezierCurveTo(x + w * 0.98, y + h * 0.92, x + w * 1.05, y + h * 0.26, x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.16);
                c.closePath();
                var g = c.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x + w, 0);
                g.addColorStop(0, "#2b8492");
                g.addColorStop(0.32, "#5cbfcb");
                g.addColorStop(0.58, "#8adde2");
                g.addColorStop(1, "#26707e");
                c.fillStyle = g;
                c.fill();
                c.beginPath();
                c.moveTo(x + w * 0.33, y + h * 0.055);
                c.lineTo(x + w * 0.67, y + h * 0.055);
                c.lineTo(x + w * 0.60, y + h * 0.20);
                c.lineTo(x + w * 0.40, y + h * 0.20);
                c.closePath();
                c.fillStyle = "#3f9dab";
                c.fill();
                c.beginPath();
                c.ellipse(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.055, w * 0.17, h * 0.02, 0, 0, TAU);
                c.fillStyle = "#96e6e8";
                c.fill();
                c.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
                c.lineWidth = Math.max(2, h * 0.012);
                c.beginPath();
                c.ellipse(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.56, w * 0.30, h * 0.04, 0, 0, Math.PI);
                c.stroke();
                c.beginPath();
                c.ellipse(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.72, w * 0.24, h * 0.03, 0, 0, Math.PI);
                c.stroke();
                c.save();
                c.globalAlpha = 0.35;
                c.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
                c.beginPath();
                c.ellipse(x + w * 0.34, y + h * 0.46, w * 0.05, h * 0.15, -0.2, 0, TAU);
                c.fill();
                c.restore();
            }
        };
        /* ---------- 老窗户 ---------- */ var WINDOW = {
            silhouette: function silhouette(c, b) {
                rr(c, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 6);
            },
            paint: function paint(c, b) {
                var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h;
                var fr = Math.min(w, h) * 0.07;
                c.beginPath();
                rr(c, x, y, w, h, 6);
                c.fillStyle = "#8d6e4e";
                c.fill();
                var gx = x + fr, gy = y + fr, gw = w - fr * 2, gh = h - fr * 2;
                var g = c.createLinearGradient(gx, gy, gx + gw, gy + gh);
                g.addColorStop(0, "#cfe9ff");
                g.addColorStop(0.5, "#a9d3f0");
                g.addColorStop(1, "#8bbde4");
                c.fillStyle = g;
                c.fillRect(gx, gy, gw, gh);
                c.fillStyle = "#8d6e4e";
                c.fillRect(x + w * 0.5 - fr * 0.32, gy, fr * 0.64, gh);
                c.fillRect(gx, y + h * 0.44 - fr * 0.32, gw, fr * 0.64);
                c.save();
                c.beginPath();
                c.rect(gx, gy, gw, gh);
                c.clip();
                c.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
                c.lineWidth = fr * 0.5;
                c.beginPath();
                c.moveTo(gx + gw * 0.15, gy + gh);
                c.lineTo(gx + gw * 0.45, gy);
                c.stroke();
                c.restore();
                c.fillStyle = "#77593c";
                c.fillRect(x - w * 0.04, y + h, w * 1.08, Math.max(6, h * 0.05));
            }
        };
        /* ---------- 轮毂 ---------- */ var HUB = {
            silhouette: function silhouette(c, b) {
                var r = Math.min(b.w, b.h) * 0.5;
                var cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
                c.moveTo(cx + r, cy);
                c.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, TAU);
            },
            paint: function paint(c, b) {
                var r = Math.min(b.w, b.h) * 0.5;
                var cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
                var i;
                c.beginPath();
                c.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, TAU);
                c.fillStyle = "#2a2f37";
                c.fill();
                c.strokeStyle = "#3d434e";
                c.lineWidth = r * 0.03;
                for(i = 0; i < 28; i++){
                    var a = i / 28 * TAU;
                    c.beginPath();
                    c.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.86, cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.86);
                    c.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.96, cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.96);
                    c.stroke();
                }
                c.beginPath();
                c.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.72, 0, TAU);
                c.fillStyle = "#cfd9e4";
                c.fill();
                c.save();
                c.fillStyle = "#aab6c4";
                for(i = 0; i < 5; i++){
                    var ang = i / 5 * TAU - Math.PI / 2;
                    c.save();
                    c.translate(cx, cy);
                    c.rotate(ang);
                    c.beginPath();
                    c.moveTo(-r * 0.10, -r * 0.22);
                    c.lineTo(r * 0.10, -r * 0.22);
                    c.lineTo(r * 0.16, -r * 0.68);
                    c.lineTo(-r * 0.16, -r * 0.68);
                    c.closePath();
                    c.fill();
                    c.restore();
                }
                c.restore();
                c.beginPath();
                c.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.26, 0, TAU);
                c.fillStyle = "#8b98a8";
                c.fill();
                c.beginPath();
                c.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.12, 0, TAU);
                c.fillStyle = "#cfd9e4";
                c.fill();
                c.fillStyle = "#6d7a8a";
                for(i = 0; i < 5; i++){
                    var a2 = i / 5 * TAU + 0.3;
                    c.beginPath();
                    c.arc(cx + Math.cos(a2) * r * 0.19, cy + Math.sin(a2) * r * 0.19, r * 0.045, 0, TAU);
                    c.fill();
                }
            }
        };

            function region(base, id, name, regions, density, water, grease) {

                        streaks: base.dirt.streaks,
                        specks: base.dirt.specks,
                        regions: regions
                    },
                    grease: grease || []
                };

   * 软泥 → 冲洗   厚泥 → 泡沫   硬垢 → 刮刀   漆损 → 补漆
   * 一种脏只认一把工具，这样每把工具才有存在感 */ (function() {
            var HEAVY = {
                van: 0.9,
                jeep: 1.05,
                truck: 1.1,
                black: 1.2,
                black_bottom: 1.2,
                sedan_wheel: 1.2
            };
            var PAINT = {
                coupe: [

                if (PAINT[lv.id]) lv.paint = PAINT[lv.id];
            }
        })();
        /* ---------- 一单多车 ----------
   * fleet 里按顺序放关卡 id，共用一个水箱。
   * 第一辆省下来的水，就是第二辆的余量。 */ NS.LEVELS.push({
            id: "combo_sedan_van",

        });
        /* ---------- id 索引（多车订单要按 id 找子关卡） ---------- */ NS.LEVEL_INDEX = {};
        for(var li = 0; li < NS.LEVELS.length; li++){
            NS.LEVEL_INDEX[NS.LEVELS[li].id] = NS.LEVELS[li];
        }
        /* ---------- 位图素材（assets.js 生成后才有） ----------
   * art.img：用位图替换矢量绘制，位图的 alpha 直接当污渍遮罩
   * bg：整屏背景图；dirt.tex：污渍贴图 */ (function() {
            var ART = {
                sedan: "car_sedan",

                truck: "car_truck",

                hub: "bg_dusk"

            for(var i = 0; i < NS.LEVELS.length; i++){
                var lv = NS.LEVELS[i];
                if (ART[lv.id]) lv.art.img = ART[lv.id];

            }
            // 污渍贴图按配方挂上
            MUD.tex = "dirt_soft";
            DUST.tex = "dirt_soft";
            GREASE.tex = "grime_hard";
        // GRAFFITI 保持程序化：涂鸦要的是硬边色块，贴图反而糊
        })();
        /* ---------- 升级表 ----------
   * 幅度刻意保守：满级约等于两倍效率。
   * 幅度太大会让"升满"直接吃掉游戏内容。 */ NS.UPGRADES = [
            {
                key: "pressure",
                name: "水压",
                icon: "\uD83D\uDCA6",
                max: 5,
                costs: [
                    60,

    /* =====================================================================
 * 亮车计划 · 可玩原型
 *
 * v2 相比 v1：升级系统（水压/喷嘴/除油剂）、金币与存档、
 * 10 个关卡、4 类物体、3 种脏法。

 * 调试：?lv=3 指定关卡；?auto=1 自动扫射；?fresh=1 清空存档
 * =================================================================== */ (function() {
        "use strict";
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
   * 0. 画布与工具
   * ------------------------------------------------------------- */ var stage = document.getElementById("stage");
        var cv = document.getElementById("game");
        var ctx = cv.getContext("2d", {
            alpha: false
        });
        var dirtCv = document.createElement("canvas");
        var dctx = dirtCv.getContext("2d");
        var heavyCv = document.createElement("canvas"); // 厚泥层：盖在软泥上面，只能用泡沫
        var hctx = heavyCv.getContext("2d");
        var grainCv = null;
        var IMAGES = {}; // 位图素材（assets.js 里的 data URI）
        var imagesReady = false;
        function loadImages(done) {
            var src = window.CW_IMG || {};
            var keys = Object.keys(src);
            if (!keys.length) {
                imagesReady = true;
                done();
                return;
            }
            var left = keys.length;
            keys.forEach(function(k) {
                var im = wx.createImage();
                function finish() {
                    if (--left === 0) {
                        imagesReady = true;
                        done();
                    }
                }
                im.onload = function() {
                    im.__ok = true;
                    try {
                        im.complete = true;
                    } catch (e) {}
                    if (!im.naturalWidth) {
                        try {
                            im.naturalWidth = im.width;
                            im.naturalHeight = im.height;
                        } catch (e) {}
                    }
                    finish();
                };
                im.onerror = function() {
                    try {
                        im.complete = true;
                    } catch (e) {}
                    finish();
                };
                im.src = src[k];
                IMAGES[k] = im;
            });
        }
        function imgOf(name) {
            var im = name && IMAGES[name];
            return im && (im.__ok || im.complete && im.naturalWidth) ? im : null;
        }
        var trimCache = {};
        var tintCache = {};
        var softCache = {};
        /**
   * 柔边贴图：把贴图的 alpha 乘一个径向渐变，边缘淡到 0。
   * 这是消除"贴图边界感"的关键 —— 硬边贴图叠在一起就会露出方形/圆形接缝。
   */ function softTex(name) {
            var im = imgOf(name);
            if (!im) return null;
            if (softCache[name]) return softCache[name];
            var w = im.naturalWidth, h = im.naturalHeight;
            var c = document.createElement("canvas");
            c.width = w;
            c.height = h;
            var g = c.getContext("2d");
            g.drawImage(im, 0, 0);
            g.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-in";
            var grd = g.createRadialGradient(w / 2, h / 2, 0, w / 2, h / 2, Math.min(w, h) * 0.5);
            grd.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,1)");
            grd.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(0,0,0,1)");
            grd.addColorStop(0.74, "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)");
            grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
            g.fillStyle = grd;
            g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
            g.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
            softCache[name] = c;
            return c;
        }
        /** 给贴图染色（source-atop 只作用在已有像素上，保留裂纹和 alpha） */ function tintedTex(name, tint) {
            var im = imgOf(name);
            if (!im) return null;
            var key = name + "|" + tint;
            if (tintCache[key]) return tintCache[key];
            var c = document.createElement("canvas");
            c.width = im.naturalWidth;
            c.height = im.naturalHeight;
            var g = c.getContext("2d");
            g.drawImage(im, 0, 0);
            g.globalCompositeOperation = "source-atop";
            g.fillStyle = tint;
            g.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
            // 同样做柔边，避免厚泥块露出方形接缝
            g.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-in";
            var grd = g.createRadialGradient(c.width / 2, c.height / 2, 0, c.width / 2, c.height / 2, Math.min(c.width, c.height) * 0.5);
            grd.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,1)");
            grd.addColorStop(0.52, "rgba(0,0,0,1)");
            grd.addColorStop(0.76, "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)");
            grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
            g.fillStyle = grd;
            g.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
            g.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
            tintCache[key] = c;
            return c;
        }
        /** 裁掉透明留白：生成图四周有空白，不裁的话物体在屏幕上会显得很小 */ function trimOf(name) {
            var im = imgOf(name);
            if (!im) return null;
            if (trimCache[name]) return trimCache[name];
            var w = im.naturalWidth, h = im.naturalHeight;
            var c = document.createElement("canvas");
            c.width = w;
            c.height = h;
            var g = c.getContext("2d");
            g.drawImage(im, 0, 0);
            var d;
            try {
                d = g.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;
            } catch (e) {
                trimCache[name] = {
                    x: 0,
                    y: 0,
                    w: w,
                    h: h
                };
                return trimCache[name];
            }
            var x0 = w, y0 = h, x1 = -1, y1 = -1, x, y;
            for(y = 0; y < h; y++){
                for(x = 0; x < w; x++){
                    if (d[(y * w + x) * 4 + 3] > 60) {
                        if (x < x0) x0 = x;
                        if (x > x1) x1 = x;
                        if (y < y0) y0 = y;
                        if (y > y1) y1 = y;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x1 < 0) {
                trimCache[name] = {
                    x: 0,
                    y: 0,
                    w: w,
                    h: h
                };
                return trimCache[name];
            }
            var pad = Math.round(Math.min(w, h) * 0.015);
            x0 = Math.max(0, x0 - pad);
            y0 = Math.max(0, y0 - pad);
            x1 = Math.min(w - 1, x1 + pad);
            y1 = Math.min(h - 1, y1 + pad);
            trimCache[name] = {
                x: x0,
                y: y0,
                w: x1 - x0 + 1,
                h: y1 - y0 + 1
            };
            return trimCache[name];
        }
        /** 把物体画进 b（自动按裁边后的比例拉伸） */ function drawArt(c, b, name) {
            var im = imgOf(name);
            if (!im) return false;
            var t = trimOf(name) || {
                x: 0,
                y: 0,
                w: im.naturalWidth,
                h: im.naturalHeight
            };
            c.drawImage(im, t.x, t.y, t.w, t.h, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
            return true;
        }
        var tintCv = document.createElement("canvas"); // 高亮用的临时层
        var tctx = tintCv.getContext("2d");
        var beforeCv = document.createElement("canvas"); // 开洗前的脏污快照，用于对比
        var bctx = beforeCv.getContext("2d");

            willReadFrequently: true
        });
        var NS = window.CW;

        var QS = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
        var AUTO = QS.has("auto");
        // 刘海屏安全区（微信适配层会设置；浏览器里为 0）
        var SAFE_TOP = typeof window !== "undefined" && window.__SAFE_TOP || 0;
        var FONT = 'system-ui,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif';
        var TAU = Math.PI * 2;
        function clamp(v, a, b) {
            return v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v;
        }
        function lerp(a, b, t) {
            return a + (b - a) * t;
        }
        function rand(a, b) {
            return a + Math.random() * (b - a);
        }
        function hexRGB(h) {
            var n = parseInt(h.slice(1), 16);
            return [
                n >> 16 & 255,
                n >> 8 & 255,
                n & 255
            ];
        }
        function mixHex(a, b, t) {
            var A = hexRGB(a), B = hexRGB(b);
            return "rgb(" + Math.round(A[0] + (B[0] - A[0]) * t) + "," + Math.round(A[1] + (B[1] - A[1]) * t) + "," + Math.round(A[2] + (B[2] - A[2]) * t) + ")";
        }
        function rr(c, x, y, w, h, r) {
            r = Math.max(0, Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2));
            c.moveTo(x + r, y);
            c.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
            c.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
            c.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
            c.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
            c.closePath();
        }
        function starPath(c, cx, cy, r) {
            c.beginPath();
            for(var i = 0; i < 10; i++){
                var a = -Math.PI / 2 + i * Math.PI / 5;
                var rad = i % 2 === 0 ? r : r * 0.45;
                var px = cx + Math.cos(a) * rad, py = cy + Math.sin(a) * rad;
                if (i === 0) c.moveTo(px, py);
                else c.lineTo(px, py);
            }
            c.closePath();
        }
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
   * 1. 存档
   * ------------------------------------------------------------- */ var SAVE_KEY = "chongyichong.save.v2";
        function defaultSave() {
            return {
                coins: 0,
                up: {
                    pressure: 1,
                    nozzle: 1,
                    detergent: 1
                },
                best: {},
                idx: 0,
                level: 1,
                xp: 0,
                washes: 0,
                daily: {
                    d: "",
                    n: 0
                } // 今天洗了几辆
            };
        }
        /** 升到下一级需要的经验 */ function xpForNext(lv) {
            return 100 + (lv - 1) * 60;
        }
        function todayKey() {
            var d = new Date();
            return d.getFullYear() + "-" + (d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + d.getDate();
        }
        /** 跨天自动清零今日计数 */ function refreshDaily() {
            var k = todayKey();
            if (save.daily.d !== k) {
                save.daily.d = k;
                save.daily.n = 0;
            }
        }
        var DAILY_GOAL = 5;
        function loadSave() {
            var s = null;
            if (!QS.has("fresh")) {
                try {
                    s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY) || "null");
                } catch (e) {
                    s = null;
                }
            }
            var d = defaultSave();
            if (!s || typeof s !== "object") return d;
            s.coins = Math.max(0, s.coins | 0);
            s.up = s.up || {};
            for(var k in d.up)s.up[k] = clamp(s.up[k] | 0 || 1, 1, 5);
            s.best = s.best || {};
            s.idx = clamp(s.idx | 0, 0, LEVELS.length - 1);
            // 老存档没有这些字段，补默认值
            s.level = clamp(s.level | 0 || 1, 1, 99);
            s.xp = Math.max(0, s.xp | 0);
            s.washes = Math.max(0, s.washes | 0);
            s.daily = s.daily || {};
            s.daily.d = s.daily.d || "";
            s.daily.n = Math.max(0, s.daily.n | 0);
            // 经验可能超过上限（改过曲线），往前推
            var guard = 0;
            while(s.xp >= xpForNext(s.level) && guard++ < 200){
                s.xp -= xpForNext(s.level);
                s.level++;
            }
            return s;
        }
        function persist() {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(save));
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        /** 把成绩写进微信云存储，好友排行榜才能读到 */ function syncRank() {
            try {
                if (typeof wx === "undefined") return;
                if (!wx.setUserCloudStorage) return;
                wx.setUserCloudStorage({
                    KVDataList: [
                        {
                            key: "level",
                            value: String(save.level)
                        },
                        {
                            key: "washes",
                            value: String(save.washes)
                        },
                        {
                            key: "score",
                            value: String(save.level * 1000 + save.washes)
                        }
                    ],
                    fail: function fail() {}
                });
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        /* ---------------- 分享 / 录屏 ---------------- */ var SHARE_IMG = "images/share_cover.jpg";
        var recMgr = null;

        function shareTitle() {
            var t = "我在《亮车计划》洗到 Lv." + save.level + "，累计洗了 " + save.washes + " 辆";

        }
        function setupShare() {
            try {
                if (typeof wx === "undefined") return;
                if (wx.showShareMenu) {
                    wx.showShareMenu({
                        withShareTicket: true,
                        menus: [
                            "shareAppMessage",
                            "shareTimeline"
                        ]
                    });
                }
                if (wx.onShareAppMessage) {
                    wx.onShareAppMessage(function() {
                        return {
                            title: shareTitle(),
                            imageUrl: SHARE_IMG
                        };
                    });
                }
                if (wx.onShareTimeline) {
                    wx.onShareTimeline(function() {
                        return {
                            title: shareTitle(),
                            imageUrl: SHARE_IMG
                        };
                    });
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        function shareNow() {
            try {
                if (typeof wx === "undefined" || !wx.shareAppMessage) {
                    toast("分享需要在微信里使用");
                    return;
                }
                // 有录像就分享录像（更吸引人），否则分享成绩卡片
                if (recVideoPath) {
                    wx.shareAppMessage({
                        channel: "video",
                        extra: {
                            videoPath: recVideoPath,
                            videoTitle: shareTitle()
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    wx.shareAppMessage({
                        title: shareTitle(),
                        imageUrl: SHARE_IMG
                    });
                }
                blip(880);
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        function setupRecorder() {
            try {
                if (typeof wx === "undefined" || !wx.getGameRecorderManager) return;
                recMgr = wx.getGameRecorderManager();
                recMgr.onStop(function(res) {
                    recActive = false;
                    if (res && res.videoPath) {
                        recVideoPath = res.videoPath;
                        toast("录像已保存，可以分享");
                    }
                });
                recMgr.onError(function() {
                    recActive = false;
                });
            } catch (e) {
                recMgr = null;
            }
        }
        function startRecording() {
            if (!recMgr || recActive) return;
            try {
                recMgr.start({
                    duration: 60
                });
                recActive = true;
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        function stopRecording() {
            if (!recMgr || !recActive) return;
            try {
                recMgr.stop();
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        /** 取某点的 alpha（0..1），用来判断指针下面是哪种污渍 */ var probe2 = null, probe2ctx = null;
        function alphaAt(cv, x, y) {
            if (!probe2) {
                probe2 = document.createElement("canvas");
                probe2.width = 2;
                probe2.height = 2;
                probe2ctx = probe2.getContext("2d", {
                    willReadFrequently: true
                });
            }
            try {
                probe2ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 2, 2);
                probe2ctx.drawImage(cv, x * DPR - DPR, y * DPR - DPR, 4, 4, 0, 0, 2, 2);
                var d = probe2ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 2, 2).data;
                var mx = 0;
                for(var i = 3; i < d.length; i += 4)if (d[i] > mx) mx = d[i];
                return mx / 255;
            } catch (e) {
                return 0;
            }
        }
        var zen = false; // 禅模式：无限水、无星级、纯解压
        // 水量：这一版的"代价"。冲得慢、冲得散 = 浪费水 = 拿不到星
        var WATER_RATE = 10; // 每秒消耗
        var water = 120, waterMax = 120;
        var waterSpent = 0; // 本关累计用水，仅用于调平衡
        var dryT = 0; // >0 表示断水结算倒计时
        var finishReason = ""; // complete | dry
        var finalWater = 0, finalProgress = 0;
        var hasLayout = false;
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
   * 4. 尺寸
   * ------------------------------------------------------------- */ function resize() {
            var r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
            var nw = Math.max(300, Math.round(r.width));
            var nh = Math.max(420, Math.round(r.height));
            // 移动端地址栏收起/展开只拉伸画布，不重置关卡
            if (hasLayout && Math.abs(nw - W) < 80 && Math.abs(nh - H) < 180) {
                cv.style.width = nw + "px";
                cv.style.height = nh + "px";
                return;
            }
            hasLayout = true;
            W = nw;
            H = nh;
            DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
            cv.width = Math.round(W * DPR);
            cv.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
            cv.style.width = W + "px";
            cv.style.height = H + "px";
            [
                dirtCv,
                cleanCv,
                beforeCv,
                heavyCv,
                tintCv
            ].forEach(function(c) {
                c.width = cv.width;
                c.height = cv.height;
            });
            ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
            dctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
            cctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
            bctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
            hctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
            tctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
            if (order) loadPart(partIdx, water);
            else configureLevel();
        }
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
   * 5. 关卡装配
   * ------------------------------------------------------------- */ function configureLevel() {
            bounds = {
                x: W * level.bounds.x,
                y: H * level.bounds.y,
                w: W * level.bounds.w,
                h: H * level.bounds.h
            };
            // 有位图时按"裁边后"的宽高比居中收进 bounds，避免拉伸变形
            var artImg = imgOf(level.art.img);
            if (artImg) {
                var tt = trimOf(level.art.img) || {
                    w: artImg.naturalWidth,
                    h: artImg.naturalHeight
                };
                var sc = Math.min(bounds.w / tt.w, bounds.h / tt.h);
                var fw = tt.w * sc, fh = tt.h * sc;
                bounds = {
                    x: bounds.x + (bounds.w - fw) / 2,
                    y: bounds.y + (bounds.h - fh) / 2,
                    w: fw,
                    h: fh
                };
            }
            glossBucket = -1;
            bakeClean(0);
            bakeDirt();
            bakeHeavy();
            makeGrease();
            makePaint();
            // 洗前快照 = 软泥 + 厚泥
            bctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            bctx.clearRect(0, 0, beforeCv.width, beforeCv.height);
            bctx.drawImage(dirtCv, 0, 0);
            bctx.drawImage(heavyCv, 0, 0);
            captureBaseline();
            progress = 0;
            progShown = 0;
            finishing = false;
            finishT = 0;
            shineT = 0;
            state = "play";
            parts.length = 0;
            buttons = [];
            firstSpray = true;
            sampleTimer = 0;
            autoT = 0;
            lastGain = 0;
            coinShown = 0;
            coinTarget = 0;
            lastXP = 0;
            levelUpTo = 0;
            recVideoPath = null;
            waterMax = level.water || 120;
            water = waterMax;
            waterSpent = 0;
            dryT = 0;
            foamMax = Math.round((level.foam || 100) * FOAM_BONUS);
            foam = foamMax;
            foamDots.length = 0;
            tool = "rinse";
            heavyLeftFrac = level.heavy ? 1 : 0;
            toastT = 0;
            toastMsg = "";
            if (zen) {
                water = 1e9;
                waterMax = 1e9;
                foam = 1e9;
                foamMax = 1e9;
            }
            finishReason = "";
            startTime = performance.now();
            doneAt = 0;
            elapsed = 0;
        }
        /** 车漆高光随清洁度增长：越干净越亮，脏东西盖住的地方自然看不到 */ function bakeClean(gloss) {
            cctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            cctx.clearRect(0, 0, cleanCv.width, cleanCv.height);
            cctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
            var b = bounds;
            if (!drawArt(cctx, b, level.art.img)) {
                level.art.paint(cctx, b);
            }
            gloss = gloss || 0;
            if (gloss > 0.02) {
                cctx.save();
                // source-atop：只画在已有像素上，位图和矢量都适用
                cctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-atop";
                var g = cctx.createLinearGradient(b.x, b.y + b.h * 0.15, b.x + b.w * 0.75, b.y + b.h);
                g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
                g.addColorStop(0.28, "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.30 * gloss).toFixed(3) + ")");
                g.addColorStop(0.42, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
                g.addColorStop(0.60, "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.14 * gloss).toFixed(3) + ")");
                g.addColorStop(0.76, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
                cctx.fillStyle = g;
                cctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
                cctx.restore();
            }
        }
        function updateGloss() {
            var bucket = Math.floor(progress * 8);
            if (bucket === glossBucket) return;
            glossBucket = bucket;
            bakeClean(progress);
        }
        function fadeOf(color) {
            return color.replace(/,\s*[\d.]+\)$/, ",0)");
        }
        function bakeDirt() {
            dctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
            dctx.clearRect(0, 0, dirtCv.width, dirtCv.height);
            dctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
            var b = bounds;
            var cfg = level.dirt;
            var rec = cfg.recipe;
            var density = cfg.density || 0.8;
            var i;
            dctx.save();
            // 有纹理贴图就用贴图去"盖"，没有就程序化生成
            var tex = imgOf(cfg.tex || rec.tex);
            // 区域化脏污：同一张图只脏某个部位，就能变成一个新关卡
            var regs = cfg.regions && cfg.regions.length ? cfg.regions : null;
            if (regs) {
                dctx.beginPath();
                for(var ri = 0; ri < regs.length; ri++){
                    var RG = regs[ri];
                    dctx.rect(b.x + b.w * RG[0], b.y + b.h * RG[1], b.w * RG[2], b.h * RG[3]);
                }
                dctx.clip();
            }
            function pickPoint() {
                if (!regs) return [
                    b.x + Math.random() * b.w,
                    b.y + Math.random() * b.h
                ];
                var total = 0, i;
                for(i = 0; i < regs.length; i++)total += regs[i][2] * regs[i][3];
                var t = Math.random() * total;
                for(i = 0; i < regs.length; i++){
                    var ar = regs[i][2] * regs[i][3];
                    if (t <= ar || i === regs.length - 1) {
                        var R = regs[i];
                        return [
                            b.x + b.w * (R[0] + Math.random() * R[2]),
                            b.y + b.h * (R[1] + Math.random() * R[3])
                        ];
                    }
                    t -= ar;
                }
                return [
                    b.x + b.w * 0.5,
                    b.y + b.h * 0.5
                ];
            }
            // 底膜不再是一整片均匀色：用斜向渐变，让上下厚薄不同
            var filmG = dctx.createLinearGradient(b.x, b.y, b.x + b.w * 0.4, b.y + b.h);
            filmG.addColorStop(0, fadeOf(rec.film));
            filmG.addColorStop(0.45, rec.film);
            filmG.addColorStop(1, rec.film);
            dctx.fillStyle = filmG;
            dctx.fillRect(b.x - 6, b.y - 6, b.w + 12, b.h + 12);
            if (tex) {
                // 用"柔边版"贴图：边缘 alpha 渐变到 0，盖多少张都不会出现方块边界
                var stampTex = softTex(rec.tex || "dirt_soft") || tex;
                var tw = stampTex.width || stampTex.naturalWidth;
                var th = stampTex.height || stampTex.naturalHeight;
                var tiers = [
                    {
                        rel: 0.46,
                        n: 10,
                        a0: 0.14,
                        a1: 0.28
                    },
                    {
                        rel: 0.22,
                        n: 26,
                        a0: 0.20,
                        a1: 0.40
                    },
                    {
                        rel: 0.090,
                        n: 62,
                        a0: 0.26,
                        a1: 0.55
                    } // 碎点：细节
                ];
                for(var t2 = 0; t2 < tiers.length; t2++){
                    var tr = tiers[t2];
                    var n2 = Math.round(tr.n * density);
                    for(i = 0; i < n2; i++){
                        var tp = pickPoint();
                        var scale = b.w * tr.rel * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6) / tw;
                        var dw = tw * scale, dh = th * scale;
                        dctx.save();
                        dctx.translate(tp[0], tp[1]);
                        dctx.rotate(Math.random() * TAU);
                        // 随机镜像 + 竖向压扁，同一张图也能盖出不同形状
                        dctx.scale((Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * (0.85 + Math.random() * 0.3), 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.9);
                        dctx.globalAlpha = tr.a0 + Math.random() * (tr.a1 - tr.a0);
                        dctx.drawImage(stampTex, -dw / 2, -dh / 2, dw, dh);
                        dctx.restore();
                    }
                }
                dctx.globalAlpha = 1;
            }
            // 大块污渍（没有纹理时靠这个撑起脏感）
            var count = tex ? Math.round(10 * density) : Math.round(46 * density);
            for(i = 0; i < count; i++){
                var pt = pickPoint();
                var cx = pt[0], cy = pt[1];
                var rx = b.w * 0.025 + Math.random() * b.w * 0.085;
                var ry = rx * (0.45 + Math.random() * 0.95);
                var col = rec.palette[(i * 7 + 3) % rec.palette.length];
                dctx.save();
                dctx.translate(cx, cy);
                dctx.rotate(Math.random() * Math.PI);
                if (rec.soft) {
                    // 一层深色虚边，让污渍有厚度，不像一块平涂
                    var rg0 = dctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, rx * 0.55, 0, 0, rx * 1.12);
                    rg0.addColorStop(0, "rgba(38,28,18,0.16)");
                    rg0.addColorStop(1, "rgba(38,28,18,0)");
                    dctx.fillStyle = rg0;
                    dctx.beginPath();
                    dctx.ellipse(0, 0, rx * 1.12, ry * 1.12, 0, 0, TAU);
                    dctx.fill();
                    var rg = dctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, rx);
                    rg.addColorStop(0, col);
                    rg.addColorStop(0.62, col);
                    rg.addColorStop(1, fadeOf(col));
                    dctx.fillStyle = rg;
                } else {
                    dctx.fillStyle = col;
                }
                dctx.beginPath();
                dctx.ellipse(0, 0, rx, ry, 0, 0, TAU);
                dctx.fill();
                dctx.restore();
            }
            // 泥点
            var specks = Math.round((cfg.specks || 160) * density);
            for(i = 0; i < specks; i++){
                var sp = pickPoint();
                dctx.beginPath();
                dctx.arc(sp[0], sp[1], 0.6 + Math.random() * 2.8, 0, TAU);
                dctx.fillStyle = rec.palette[(i * 5 + 1) % rec.palette.length];
                dctx.fill();
            }
            // 流挂
            var streaks = Math.round((cfg.streaks || 10) * density);
            for(i = 0; i < streaks; i++){
                var sk = pickPoint();
                var gx = sk[0];
                var gy = sk[1];
                var gh = b.h * (0.1 + Math.random() * 0.36);
                var base = rec.palette[i % rec.palette.length];
                var lg = dctx.createLinearGradient(0, gy, 0, gy + gh);
                lg.addColorStop(0, base);
                lg.addColorStop(1, fadeOf(base));
                dctx.fillStyle = lg;
                dctx.fillRect(gx - 1.6, gy, 3.2, gh);
            }
            dctx.restore();
            // 用噪声把密度打散，破掉「一整片平涂」的感觉
            applyDensityMask(dctx, b, 0.30, 1.0);
            maskToObject(dctx, b);
        }
        /** 车身遮罩：位图 alpha 加固后作为"污渍只能长在车上"的裁剪依据 */ var maskCv = null;
        function buildBodyMask() {
            var im = imgOf(level.art.img);
            if (!im) {
                maskCv = null;
                return;
            }
            var c = document.createElement("canvas");
            c.width = cv.width;
            c.height = cv.height;
            var m = c.getContext("2d");
            if (!drawArt(m, bounds, level.art.img)) {
                maskCv = null;
                return;
            }
            // 键色抠像会留下低 alpha 散点（模型输出是 JPEG 压缩的，背景全是绿色噪声），
            // 不清零的话污渍会顺着散点长到车外的天空和草地上。
            try {
                var d = m.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
                var p = d.data;
                for(var i = 3; i < p.length; i += 4){
                    var a = p[i];
                    p[i] = a < 60 ? 0 : Math.min(255, a * 1.4);
                }
                m.putImageData(d, 0, 0);
            } catch (e) {}
            maskCv = c;
        }
        /** 区域羽化遮罩：厚泥的区域边界从硬矩形变成渐变过渡 */ var regionMaskCv = null;
        function buildRegionMask() {
            regionMaskCv = null;
            var cfg = level.heavy;
            if (!cfg || !cfg.region || !cfg.region.length) return;
            var c = document.createElement("canvas");
            c.width = Math.max(2, Math.round(bounds.w * DPR));
            c.height = Math.max(2, Math.round(bounds.h * DPR));
            var m = c.getContext("2d");
            var f = Math.min(c.width, c.height) * 0.18;
            for(var i = 0; i < cfg.region.length; i++){
                var R = cfg.region[i];
                var x = R[0] * c.width, y = R[1] * c.height;
                var w = R[2] * c.width, h = R[3] * c.height;
                m.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
                m.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
                // 四边各挖一条渐变带：边缘 alpha 从 1 渐变到 0
                m.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
                var tg = m.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, y + f);
                tg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,1)");
                tg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
                m.fillStyle = tg;
                m.fillRect(x, y, w, f);
                var bg2 = m.createLinearGradient(0, y + h, 0, y + h - f);
                bg2.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,1)");
                bg2.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
                m.fillStyle = bg2;
                m.fillRect(x, y + h - f, w, f);
                var lg = m.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x + f, 0);
                lg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,1)");
                lg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
                m.fillStyle = lg;
                m.fillRect(x, y, f, h);
                var rg2 = m.createLinearGradient(x + w, 0, x + w - f, 0);
                rg2.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,1)");
                rg2.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
                m.fillStyle = rg2;
                m.fillRect(x + w - f, y, f, h);
                m.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
            }
            regionMaskCv = c;
        }
        function applyRegionMask(c, b) {
            if (!regionMaskCv) return;
            c.save();
            c.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-in";
            c.drawImage(regionMaskCv, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
            c.restore();
        }
        /** 硬垢精灵：预先裁到车身，绘制时只随 hp 淡出 —— 永远不会溢出车身 */ var greaseSprites = [];
        function bakeGreaseSprites() {
            greaseSprites = [];
            if (!maskCv) return;
            for(var i = 0; i < grease.length; i++){
                var s = grease[i];
                if (s.hp <= 0) continue;
                var sp = greaseSprites[i];
                if (sp) {
                    // 预先裁到车身的精灵，随 hp 淡出 —— 硬垢永远不会溢出车身
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(s.hp, 0, 1);
                    ctx.drawImage(sp.cv, sp.x, sp.y, sp.r * 2, sp.r * 2);
                    ctx.restore();
                } else {
                    var rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 0, s.x, s.y, s.r);
                    rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(58,46,34," + (0.88 * s.hp).toFixed(3) + ")");
                    rg.addColorStop(0.55, "rgba(80,64,46," + (0.74 * s.hp).toFixed(3) + ")");
                    rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(80,64,46,0)");
                    ctx.fillStyle = rg;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, TAU);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
                // 硬垢的高光点（很小，居中在垢上）
                var specX = s.x - s.r * 0.26, specY = s.y - s.r * 0.28, specR = s.r * 0.38;
                var sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(specX, specY, 0, specX, specY, specR);
                sg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.42 * s.hp).toFixed(3) + ")");
                sg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
                ctx.fillStyle = sg;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(specX, specY, specR, 0, TAU);
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }
        /** 选中工具时，把"这把工具能处理的目标"点亮 —— 让工具和污渍的对应关系不用记 */ function drawToolHighlight() {
            if (state !== "play" || finishing) return;
            var pulse = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 300);
            if (tool === "foam" && heavyLeftFrac > 0.02) {
                tctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
                tctx.clearRect(0, 0, tintCv.width, tintCv.height);
                // 先画一圈投影光晕，再把内部挖掉 —— 只留外缘发光，不给物体染色
                tctx.save();
                tctx.shadowColor = "rgba(120,228,255," + (0.55 + 0.30 * pulse).toFixed(3) + ")";
                tctx.shadowBlur = 16 * DPR;
                tctx.shadowOffsetX = 0;
                tctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;
                tctx.drawImage(heavyCv, 0, 0);
                tctx.restore();
                tctx.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
                tctx.drawImage(heavyCv, 0, 0);
                tctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
                ctx.drawImage(tintCv, 0, 0, W, H);
            }
            var i;
            if (tool === "scrape") {
                for(i = 0; i < grease.length; i++){
                    var g = grease[i];
                    if (g.hp <= 0) continue;
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,186,92," + (0.55 + 0.35 * pulse).toFixed(3) + ")";
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(g.x, g.y, g.r * 1.02, 0, TAU);
                    ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.restore();
                }
            }
            if (tool === "paint") {
                for(i = 0; i < paintSpots.length; i++){
                    var s = paintSpots[i];
                    if (s.hp <= 0) continue;
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(158,138,255," + (0.6 + 0.35 * pulse).toFixed(3) + ")";
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r * 1.08, 0, TAU);
                    ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.restore();
                }
            }
        }
        function drawShine() {
            if (shineT <= 0) return;
            var b = bounds;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.beginPath();
            level.art.silhouette(ctx, b);
            ctx.clip();
            var sweep = -1 + shineT * 3;
            var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(b.x + b.w * sweep, b.y, b.x + b.w * (sweep + 0.55), b.y + b.h);
            g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
            g.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.55 * (1 - Math.abs(shineT - 0.5) * 1.4)).toFixed(3) + ")");
            g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
            ctx.fillStyle = g;
            ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
            ctx.restore();
        }
        function nozzleColor() {
            var lv = save.up.pressure;
            return [
                "#5a6577",
                "#4f7fa8",
                "#3f9fc0",
                "#2fb7a0",
                "#2fc46a"
            ][lv - 1];
        }
        function drawWater() {
            if (!pointer.down || state !== "play" || finishing) return;
            // 刮刀不是水枪：只画一个金属环 + 火星，没有水柱
            if (tool === "scrape") {
                var sr = brushRadius();
                ctx.save();
                ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.45)";
                ctx.lineWidth = 3;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(pointer.x, pointer.y, sr * 0.62, 0, TAU);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,206,140,0.85)";
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(pointer.x, pointer.y, sr * 0.5, 0, TAU);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.restore();
                return;
            }
            var nx = W * 0.90, ny = H - 108;
            var px = pointer.x, py = pointer.y;
            var midX = (nx + px) * 0.5 + 18;
            var midY = Math.min(ny, py) - 90;
            var r = brushRadius();
            // 水快没了，水流跟着变细
            var wl = waterMax > 0 ? water / waterMax : 1;
            var thin = wl < 0.25 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * (wl / 0.25) : 1;
            var isFoam = tool === "foam";
            var tt = performance.now() / 1000;
            // 沿贝塞尔生成一条带抖动的水带（比直线像多了）
            function jetRibbon(width, alpha, color, wob, phase) {
                var mx = (nx + px) * 0.5 + 20;
                var my = Math.min(ny, py) - 70;
                var N = 16, left = [], right = [], i;
                for(i = 0; i <= N; i++){
                    var t = i / N;
                    var bx = (1 - t) * (1 - t) * nx + 2 * (1 - t) * t * mx + t * t * px;
                    var by = (1 - t) * (1 - t) * ny + 2 * (1 - t) * t * my + t * t * py;
                    var dx = 2 * (1 - t) * (mx - nx) + 2 * t * (px - mx);
                    var dy = 2 * (1 - t) * (my - ny) + 2 * t * (py - my);
                    var len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
                    var nxv = -dy / len, nyv = dx / len;
                    var w = width * (1 - 0.6 * t) * (0.82 + 0.18 * Math.sin(tt * 17 + i * 1.5 + phase));
                    var off = Math.sin(tt * 8 + i * 0.85 + phase) * wob;
                    left.push([
                        bx + nxv * (w + off),
                        by + nyv * (w + off)
                    ]);
                    right.push([
                        bx - nxv * (w + off),
                        by - nyv * (w + off)
                    ]);
                }
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(left[0][0], left[0][1]);
                for(i = 1; i < left.length; i++)ctx.lineTo(left[i][0], left[i][1]);
                for(i = right.length - 1; i >= 0; i--)ctx.lineTo(right[i][0], right[i][1]);
                ctx.closePath();
                ctx.fillStyle = color;
                ctx.fill();
            }
            ctx.save();
            // 三层水带：外层雾 → 中层 → 亮芯
            if (isFoam) {
                jetRibbon(32 * thin, 0.30, "rgba(236,248,255,0.30)", 3, 0);
                jetRibbon(19 * thin, 0.55, "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)", 2, 1.7);
                jetRibbon(10 * thin, 0.92, "rgba(255,255,255,0.92)", 1.2, 3.1);
            } else {
                jetRibbon(26 * thin, 0.26, "rgba(150,208,246,0.26)", 3.4, 0);
                jetRibbon(15 * thin, 0.52, "rgba(206,238,255,0.52)", 2.2, 1.7);
                jetRibbon(6 * thin, 0.95, "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)", 1.1, 3.1);
            }
            // 顺流的小水珠
            for(var q = 0; q < 5; q++){
                var qt = (tt * 2.4 + q * 0.21) % 1;
                var qx = (1 - qt) * (1 - qt) * nx + 2 * (1 - qt) * qt * ((nx + px) * 0.5 + 20) + qt * qt * px;
                var qy = (1 - qt) * (1 - qt) * ny + 2 * (1 - qt) * qt * (Math.min(ny, py) - 95) + qt * qt * py;
                var qr = (1 - qt) * 3.2 * thin + 0.8;
                ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.5 * (1 - qt) + 0.1).toFixed(2) + ")";
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(qx + rand(-4, 4), qy + rand(-4, 4), qr, 0, TAU);
                ctx.fill();
            }
            // 冲击点：光斑 + 两圈扩散环
            var r = brushRadius();
            var ig = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, r * 1.3);
            ig.addColorStop(0, isFoam ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.46)");
            ig.addColorStop(0.42, isFoam ? "rgba(240,250,255,0.26)" : "rgba(206,238,255,0.22)");
            ig.addColorStop(1, "rgba(206,238,255,0)");
            ctx.fillStyle = ig;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(px, py, r * 1.3, 0, TAU);
            ctx.fill();
            for(var rg = 0; rg < 2; rg++){
                var rt = (tt * 2.2 + rg * 0.5) % 1;
                ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255," + (0.34 * (1 - rt)).toFixed(3) + ")";
                ctx.lineWidth = 2.2 * (1 - rt) + 0.6;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.ellipse(px, py, r * (0.45 + rt * 1.1), r * (0.3 + rt * 0.75), 0, 0, TAU);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            ctx.restore();
            // 水枪（随水压等级变色变粗）
            var lv = save.up.pressure;
            var ang = Math.atan2(ny - py, nx - px);
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(nx, ny);
            ctx.rotate(ang);
            ctx.fillStyle = "#3b4655";
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, -6 - lv, -22, 12 + lv * 2, 70, 5);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = nozzleColor();
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, -4 - lv * 0.5, -14, 8 + lv, 20, 3);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
        }
        /** 工具图标：全部用矢量画，不额外占资源 */ function drawToolIcon(id, x, y, s, col) {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.strokeStyle = col;
            ctx.fillStyle = col;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.9;
            ctx.lineCap = "round";
            ctx.lineJoin = "round";
            if (id === "rinse") {
                // 水滴
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x, y - s * 0.52);
                ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + s * 0.40, y - s * 0.02, x + s * 0.34, y + s * 0.50, x, y + s * 0.50);
                ctx.bezierCurveTo(x - s * 0.34, y + s * 0.50, x - s * 0.40, y - s * 0.02, x, y - s * 0.52);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x - s * 0.10, y + s * 0.14, s * 0.09, 0, TAU);
                ctx.fill();
            } else if (id === "foam") {
                // 三个泡
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x - s * 0.16, y + s * 0.10, s * 0.30, 0, TAU);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x + s * 0.22, y - s * 0.12, s * 0.38, 0, TAU);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x - s * 0.02, y - s * 0.34, s * 0.16, 0, TAU);
                ctx.stroke();
            } else if (id === "scrape") {
                // 斜刀片 + 手柄
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x - s * 0.46, y + s * 0.10);
                ctx.lineTo(x + s * 0.18, y + s * 0.10);
                ctx.lineTo(x + s * 0.34, y - s * 0.20);
                ctx.lineTo(x - s * 0.30, y - s * 0.20);
                ctx.closePath();
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x + s * 0.36, y - s * 0.16);
                ctx.lineTo(x + s * 0.52, y + s * 0.02);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x - s * 0.40, y + s * 0.42);
                ctx.lineTo(x + s * 0.26, y + s * 0.42);
                ctx.stroke();
            } else {
                // 补漆：喷罐 + 喷点
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, x - s * 0.30, y - s * 0.18, s * 0.46, s * 0.66, s * 0.10);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, x - s * 0.18, y - s * 0.40, s * 0.22, s * 0.20, s * 0.06);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x + s * 0.34, y - s * 0.34, s * 0.07, 0, TAU);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x + s * 0.50, y - s * 0.16, s * 0.055, 0, TAU);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x + s * 0.38, y - s * 0.02, s * 0.045, 0, TAU);
                ctx.fill();
            }
            ctx.restore();
        }
        function drawHUD() {
            var pct = Math.round(progShown * 100);
            var wl = waterMax > 0 ? water / waterMax : 0;
            var low = wl < 0.25;
            // 顶部柔光遮罩
            var scrim = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 132 + SAFE_TOP);
            scrim.addColorStop(0, "rgba(12,30,44,0.28)");
            scrim.addColorStop(0.62, "rgba(12,30,44,0.10)");
            scrim.addColorStop(1, "rgba(12,30,44,0)");
            ctx.fillStyle = scrim;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 132 + SAFE_TOP);
            // ---- 玻璃信息卡 ----
            var cardX = 14, cardY = 12 + SAFE_TOP, cardW = W - 28, cardH = 96;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(10,26,40,0.20)";
            ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
            ctx.shadowOffsetY = 6;
            var cardBg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, cardY, 0, cardY + cardH);
            cardBg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.30)");
            cardBg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0.13)");
            ctx.fillStyle = cardBg;
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, cardX, cardY, cardW, cardH, 22);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
            ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.36)";
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, cardX + 0.6, cardY + 0.6, cardW - 1.2, cardH - 1.2, 21.4);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.save();
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            // 左上：等级 + 单号
            ctx.textAlign = "left";
            ctx.font = "600 10px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.66)";
            ctx.fillText("Lv." + save.level + "  \xb7  第 " + (levelIndex + 1) + "/" + LEVELS.length + " 单" + (partTotal > 1 ? " \xb7 " + (partIdx + 1) + "/" + partTotal + " 辆" : ""), cardX + 18, cardY + 21);
            // 右上：今日进度
            ctx.textAlign = "right";
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.66)";
            ctx.fillText("今日 " + save.daily.n + "/" + DAILY_GOAL + (save.daily.n >= DAILY_GOAL ? " ✓" : ""), cardX + cardW - 18, cardY + 21);
            ctx.textAlign = "left";
            // 左下：车名
            ctx.font = "700 17px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
            ctx.fillText(level.name, cardX + 18, cardY + 43);
            // 右上：大百分比
            ctx.textAlign = "right";
            ctx.font = "800 26px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
            ctx.fillText(pct + "%", cardX + cardW - 18, cardY + 42);
            // 清洁度主条
            var pbX = cardX + 18, pbW = cardW - 36, pbY = cardY + 60, pbH = 9;
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.20)";
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, pbX, pbY, pbW, pbH, pbH / 2);
            ctx.fill();
            var fw = Math.max(pbH, pbW * progShown);
            var pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(pbX, 0, pbX + pbW, 0);
            pg.addColorStop(0, "#8af3c6");
            pg.addColorStop(1, "#1fae82");
            ctx.fillStyle = pg;
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, pbX, pbY, fw, pbH, pbH / 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, pbX + 2, pbY + 1.5, Math.max(5, fw - 4), 3, 1.5);
            ctx.fill();
            // 水量细条（带水滴和星级刻度）
            if (!zen) {
                var wy = cardY + 78, wh = 5;
                ctx.fillStyle = low ? "#f0a95e" : "#8dd3f7";
                var dx = cardX + 21, dy = wy + wh / 2;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(dx, dy - 5);
                ctx.bezierCurveTo(dx + 4, dy - 1, dx + 3.2, dy + 4, dx, dy + 4);
                ctx.bezierCurveTo(dx - 3.2, dy + 4, dx - 4, dy - 1, dx, dy - 5);
                ctx.fill();
                var wbx = cardX + 31, wbw = cardW - 49;
                ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, wbx, wy, wbw, wh, wh / 2);
                ctx.fill();
                var ww = Math.max(wh, wbw * wl);
                var wgd = ctx.createLinearGradient(wbx, 0, wbx + wbw, 0);
                if (low) {
                    wgd.addColorStop(0, "#ffc98c");
                    wgd.addColorStop(1, "#e8853a");
                } else {
                    wgd.addColorStop(0, "#a9e0ff");
