                    wgd.addColorStop(1, "#41a3dd");
                }
                ctx.fillStyle = wgd;
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, wbx, wy, ww, wh, wh / 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
                ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                var marks = [
                    0.25,
                    0.08
                ];
                for(var mi = 0; mi < marks.length; mi++){
                    var mx = wbx + wbw * marks[mi];
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(mx, wy - 2);
                    ctx.lineTo(mx, wy + wh + 2);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
            } else {
                ctx.font = "600 11px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)";
                ctx.textAlign = "right";
                ctx.fillText("禅模式", cardX + cardW - 18, cardY + 80);
            }
            ctx.restore();
            // 断水提示
            if (dryT > 0) {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(dryT / 0.9, 0, 1);
                ctx.textAlign = "center";
                ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
                ctx.fillStyle = "#b8551a";
                ctx.font = "700 18px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillText("水用完了", W / 2, H * 0.5);
                ctx.restore();
            }
            if (firstSpray && state === "play") {
                var a = 0.55 + 0.35 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 360);
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalAlpha = a;
                ctx.textAlign = "center";
                ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
                ctx.fillStyle = "#123c4d";
                ctx.font = "500 15px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillText("按住屏幕，冲掉污渍", W / 2, H - 124);
                ctx.restore();
            }
            if (state === "play" && !finishing && dryT <= 0 && progress > 0.9 && water > 0 && crustsLeft() === 0) {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.textAlign = "center";
                ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
                ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(18,60,77,0.55)";
                ctx.font = "500 13px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillText("快好了，再冲一下", W / 2, H - 124);
                ctx.restore();
            }
            // 还差什么没处理
            if (state === "play" && !finishing && (heavyLeftFrac > 0.06 || crustsLeft() > 0 || paintLeft() > 0)) {
                var need = [];
                if (heavyLeftFrac > 0.06) need.push("厚泥 \xb7 泡沫");
                if (crustsLeft() > 0) need.push(crustsLeft() + " 处硬垢 \xb7 刮刀");
                if (paintShown() > 0) need.push(paintShown() + " 处掉漆 \xb7 补漆");
                ctx.save();
                ctx.textAlign = "center";
                ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
                ctx.fillStyle = "#a8641b";
                ctx.font = "600 13px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillText("还差 " + need.join("  /  "), W / 2, H - 146);
                ctx.restore();
            }
            // 用错工具的提示
            if (toastT > 0) {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(toastT, 0, 1);
                ctx.font = "600 15px " + FONT;
                var toastW = ctx.measureText(toastMsg).width + 34;
                ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(28,36,46,0.80)";
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, W / 2 - toastW / 2, H - 182, toastW, 34, 17);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
                ctx.textAlign = "center";
                ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
                ctx.fillText(toastMsg, W / 2, H - 165);
                ctx.restore();
            }
            // 音效开关（常驻小圆钮，压在工具栏左上方）
            if (state === "play" && dryT <= 0) {
                var abx = 16, aby = H - 130, abs = 32, acx = abx + abs / 2, acy = aby + abs / 2;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.76)";
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(acx, acy, abs / 2, 0, TAU);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(24,54,74,0.16)";
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.3;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(acx, acy, abs / 2 - 0.6, 0, TAU);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.fillStyle = audioOn ? "#3d5a72" : "#b04a3a";
                ctx.strokeStyle = ctx.fillStyle;
                ctx.lineCap = "round";
                // 喇叭主体
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(acx - 7, acy - 3);
                ctx.lineTo(acx - 3, acy - 3);
                ctx.lineTo(acx + 2, acy - 7.5);
                ctx.lineTo(acx + 2, acy + 7.5);
                ctx.lineTo(acx - 3, acy + 3);
                ctx.lineTo(acx - 7, acy + 3);
                ctx.closePath();
                ctx.fill();
                if (audioOn) {
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(acx + 2, acy, 5, -0.9, 0.9);
                    ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(acx + 2, acy, 9, -0.8, 0.8);
                    ctx.stroke();
                } else {
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(acx + 6, acy - 6);
                    ctx.lineTo(acx + 12, acy + 6);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
                ctx.restore();
                buttons.push({
                    x: abx,
                    y: aby,
                    w: abs,
                    h: abs,
                    onClick: function onClick() {
                        setAudioEnabled(!audioOn);
                    }
                });
            }
            // 工具条
            if (state === "play" && !finishing && dryT <= 0) {
                var tools = [
                    {
                        id: "rinse",
                        label: "冲洗",
                        on: "#3d93d6"
                    },
                    {
                        id: "foam",
                        label: "泡沫",
                        on: "#3aa8c4"
                    },
                    {
                        id: "scrape",
                        label: "刮刀",
                        on: "#c98a3a"
                    },
                    {
                        id: "paint",
                        label: "补漆",
                        on: "#7d6fd0"
                    }
                ];
                var barX = 14, barW = W - 28, barH = 76, barY = H - 92;
                var segW = barW / 4;
                // 底座
                ctx.save();
                ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(10,26,40,0.24)";
                ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
                ctx.shadowOffsetY = 8;
                var barBg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, barY, 0, barY + barH);
                barBg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.96)");
                barBg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(240,247,252,0.96)");
                ctx.fillStyle = barBg;
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, barX, barY, barW, barH, 24);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.restore();
                ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, barX + 0.6, barY + 0.6, barW - 1.2, barH - 1.2, 23.4);
                ctx.stroke();
                for(var ti = 0; ti < tools.length; ti++){
                    var tl = tools[ti];
                    var sx = barX + ti * segW;
                    var cx = sx + segW / 2;
                    var active = tool === tl.id;
                    if (active) {
                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.shadowColor = tl.on + "88";
                        ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
                        ctx.shadowOffsetY = 4;
                        var ag = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, barY + 8, 0, barY + barH - 8);
                        ag.addColorStop(0, tl.on);
                        ag.addColorStop(1, tl.on + "dd");
                        ctx.fillStyle = ag;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        rr(ctx, sx + 7, barY + 7, segW - 14, barH - 14, 18);
                        ctx.fill();
                        ctx.restore();
                    }
                    drawToolIcon(tl.id, cx, barY + 30, 20, active ? "#ffffff" : "#4a6a80");
                    ctx.textAlign = "center";
                    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
                    ctx.font = (active ? "700 " : "600 ") + "12px " + FONT;
                    ctx.fillStyle = active ? "#ffffff" : "#5d7488";
                    ctx.fillText(tl.label, cx, barY + 58);
                    buttons.push({
                        x: sx,
                        y: barY,
                        w: segW,
                        h: barH,
                        onClick: function(id) {
                            return function() {
                                setTool(id);
                            };
                        }(tl.id)
                    });
                }
                // 泡沫余量：贴在泡沫按钮顶部的一条细线
                if (tool === "foam") {
                    var fseg = barX + segW, fy = barY - 9;
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(24,54,74,0.16)";
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    rr(ctx, fseg + 10, fy, segW - 20, 5, 2.5);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.fillStyle = "#6fd0ef";
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    rr(ctx, fseg + 10, fy, Math.max(5, (segW - 20) * foam / Math.max(1, foamMax)), 5, 2.5);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.restore();
                }
            }
        }
        /* ---- 结算 ---- */ function drawDone() {
            var a = clamp((performance.now() - doneAt) / 280, 0, 1);
            if (a <= 0) return;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalAlpha = a;
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,22,34,0.42)";
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
            var cw = Math.min(W - 52, 320);
            var chh = 386;
            var cx = (W - cw) / 2;
            var cy = (H - chh) / 2 - 10;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(16,32,48,0.30)";
            ctx.shadowBlur = 32;
            ctx.shadowOffsetY = 14;
            var cardBg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, cy, 0, cy + chh);
            cardBg.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
            cardBg.addColorStop(1, "#f2f7fb");
            ctx.fillStyle = cardBg;
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, cx, cy, cw, chh, 24);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
            ctx.textAlign = "center";
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            ctx.fillStyle = "#182a3a";
            ctx.font = "700 23px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText(finishReason === "dry" ? "水用完了 \uD83D\uDCA7" : "洗好了 ✨", W / 2, cy + 50);
            var stars = starCount();
            var age = (performance.now() - doneAt) / 1000;
            if (!zen) for(var i = 0; i < 3; i++){
                var sx = W / 2 + (i - 1) * 46, sy = cy + 100;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.translate(sx, sy);
                starPath(ctx, 0, 0, 17);
                ctx.fillStyle = "#e3e9f0";
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.restore();
                if (i < stars) {
                    var t = clamp((age - 0.22 - i * 0.13) / 0.34, 0, 1);
                    if (t > 0) {
                        // 星星背后的一圈暖光
                        var glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, 30);
                        glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,206,74," + (0.55 * t).toFixed(3) + ")");
                        glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,206,74,0)");
                        ctx.fillStyle = glow;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(sx, sy, 30, 0, TAU);
                        ctx.fill();
                        var sc = (1 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.35) * t;
                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.translate(sx, sy);
                        ctx.scale(sc, sc);
                        starPath(ctx, 0, 0, 17);
                        ctx.fillStyle = "#ffc53d";
                        ctx.fill();
                        ctx.restore();
                    }
                }
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = "#7b8b9c";
            ctx.font = "500 14px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText(zen ? "禅模式 \xb7 不计成绩" : finishReason === "dry" ? "还差 " + Math.round((1 - finalProgress) * 100) + "% 没洗完" : "剩水 " + Math.round(finalWater / Math.max(1, waterMax) * 100) + "%", W / 2, cy + 142);
            // 金币 + 经验
            if (!zen) {
                var cp = coinTarget > 0 ? clamp(coinShown / coinTarget, 0, 1) : 1;
                ctx.font = "700 " + (17 + 6 * (1 - cp)).toFixed(1) + "px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillStyle = "#e0a12a";
                ctx.fillText("\uD83D\uDCB0 +" + Math.round(coinShown), W / 2 - 62, cy + 172);
                ctx.font = "700 16px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillStyle = "#3f8fd0";
                ctx.fillText("✦ +" + lastXP, W / 2 + 66, cy + 172);
                // 等级经验条
                var need = xpForNext(save.level);
                var barW = 168, barX = W / 2 - barW / 2, barY = cy + 193, barH = 7;
                ctx.fillStyle = "#e6edf3";
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, barX, barY, barW, barH, barH / 2);
                ctx.fill();
                var lit = Math.max(barH, barW * clamp(save.xp / Math.max(1, need), 0, 1));
                var xg = ctx.createLinearGradient(barX, 0, barX + barW, 0);
                xg.addColorStop(0, "#7ec8f5");
                xg.addColorStop(1, "#2f86c8");
                ctx.fillStyle = xg;
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, barX, barY, lit, barH, barH / 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.font = "600 10px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillStyle = "#8aa0b4";
                ctx.textAlign = "left";
                ctx.fillText("Lv." + save.level, barX - 32, barY + barH / 2);
                ctx.textAlign = "right";
                ctx.fillText(save.xp + "/" + need, barX + barW + 40, barY + barH / 2);
                ctx.textAlign = "center";
            }
            // 升级横幅
            if (levelUpTo && !zen) {
                var lg2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, cy - 18, 0, cy + 18);
                lg2.addColorStop(0, "#ffd76a");
                lg2.addColorStop(1, "#f0b21f");
                ctx.save();
                ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(200,140,20,0.45)";
                ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
                ctx.shadowOffsetY = 5;
                ctx.fillStyle = lg2;
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, W / 2 - 82, cy - 17, 164, 34, 17);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.restore();
                ctx.fillStyle = "#6b4400";
                ctx.font = "800 15px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillText("升级！ Lv." + levelUpTo, W / 2, cy + 1);
            }
            buttons = [];
            var bw2 = cw - 64, bh2 = 46;
            var stars = starCount();
            var isLast = levelIndex >= LEVELS.length - 1;
            var retry = finishReason === "dry";
            var b1 = {
                x: cx + 32,
                y: cy + 224,
                w: bw2,
                h: bh2,
                onClick: retry || isLast ? restartLevel : nextLevel
            };
            ctx.fillStyle = retry ? "#e08a2e" : "#24b98a";
            var b1g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, b1.y, 0, b1.y + b1.h);
            if (retry) {
                b1g.addColorStop(0, "#f0a04a");
                b1g.addColorStop(1, "#d07a1e");
            } else {
                b1g.addColorStop(0, "#37c99a");
                b1g.addColorStop(1, "#1fa37a");
            }
            ctx.save();
            ctx.shadowColor = retry ? "rgba(180,110,20,0.35)" : "rgba(28,150,110,0.35)";
            ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
            ctx.shadowOffsetY = 5;
            ctx.fillStyle = b1g;
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, b1.x, b1.y, b1.w, b1.h, 13);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
            ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
            ctx.font = "600 16px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText(retry ? "再试一次" : isLast ? "再洗一次" : "下一单", W / 2, b1.y + bh2 / 2);
            buttons.push(b1);
            var halfW = (bw2 - 10) / 2;
            // 左下：回上一单（水不够时可以去刷钱），第一关则是重洗
            var canPrev = levelIndex > 0;
            var b2 = {
                x: cx + 32,
                y: cy + 282,
                w: halfW,
                h: 40,
                onClick: canPrev ? function() {
                    startLevel(levelIndex - 1);
                } : restartLevel
            };
            ctx.strokeStyle = "#d3dce6";
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, b2.x, b2.y, b2.w, b2.h, 12);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = "#5b6c7d";
            ctx.font = "600 14px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText(canPrev ? "← 上一单" : "再洗一次", b2.x + halfW / 2, b2.y + 20);
            buttons.push(b2);
            var b3 = {
                x: cx + 32 + halfW + 10,
                y: cy + 282,
                w: halfW,
                h: 40,
                onClick: openUpgrade
            };
            ctx.fillStyle = "#eef6f2";
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, b3.x, b3.y, b3.w, b3.h, 12);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = "#1e8f6b";
            ctx.font = "600 14px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText("升级水枪", b3.x + halfW / 2, b3.y + 20);
            buttons.push(b3);
            // 底部四个小入口：洗前洗后 / 好友排行 / 分享 / 禅模式
            var linkGap = 8;
            var linkW = (cw - 64 - linkGap * 3) / 4;
            var linkY = cy + 330;
            var l0x = cx + 32;
            var links = [
                {
                    x: l0x,
                    label: "洗前洗后",
                    color: "#8a99a8",
                    onClick: openCompare
                },
                {
                    x: l0x + (linkW + linkGap),
                    label: "好友排行",
                    color: "#2f86c8",
                    onClick: openRank
                },
                {
                    x: l0x + (linkW + linkGap) * 2,
                    label: "分享",
                    color: "#e08a2e",
                    onClick: shareNow
                },
                {
                    x: l0x + (linkW + linkGap) * 3,
                    label: zen ? "退出禅修" : "禅模式",
                    color: zen ? "#2f8f6b" : "#8a99a8",
                    onClick: toggleZen
                }
            ];
            ctx.font = "600 12px " + FONT;
            ctx.textAlign = "center";
            for(var li = 0; li < links.length; li++){
                var lk = links[li];
                ctx.fillStyle = lk.color;
                ctx.fillText(lk.label, lk.x + linkW / 2, linkY + 15);
                buttons.push({
                    x: lk.x,
                    y: linkY,
                    w: linkW,
                    h: 30,
                    onClick: lk.onClick
                });
            }
            ctx.restore();
        }
        function toggleZen() {
            zen = !zen;
            startOrder(order);
            blip(zen ? 520 : 760);
        }
        /* ---- 洗前 / 洗后 对比 ---- */ function drawCompare() {
            drawBackdrop();
            var sx = W * compareSplit;
            // 左：洗前
            ctx.save();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.rect(0, 0, sx, H);
            ctx.clip();
            ctx.drawImage(cleanCv, 0, 0, W, H);
            ctx.drawImage(beforeCv, 0, 0, W, H);
            ctx.restore();
            // 右：洗后
            ctx.save();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.rect(sx, 0, W - sx, H);
            ctx.clip();
            ctx.drawImage(cleanCv, 0, 0, W, H);
            ctx.restore();
            // 分割线 + 把手
            ctx.save();
            ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.92)";
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(sx, 0);
            ctx.lineTo(sx, H);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)";
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(sx, H * 0.52, 22, 0, TAU);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = "#4a5a6e";
            ctx.font = "600 15px " + FONT;
            ctx.textAlign = "center";
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            ctx.fillText("‹ ›", sx, H * 0.52);
            ctx.restore();
            // 标签
            ctx.save();
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            ctx.font = "600 13px " + FONT;
            var chipW = 58, chipH = 26, chipY = 84;
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(30,40,52,0.55)";
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, 20, chipY, chipW, chipH, 13);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
            ctx.textAlign = "center";
            ctx.fillText("洗前", 20 + chipW / 2, chipY + chipH / 2 + 1);
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(36,185,138,0.85)";
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, W - 20 - chipW, chipY, chipW, chipH, 13);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
            ctx.fillText("洗后", W - 20 - chipW / 2, chipY + chipH / 2 + 1);
            ctx.restore();
            // 底部提示 + 关闭
            ctx.save();
            ctx.textAlign = "center";
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,48,66,0.55)";
            ctx.font = "500 13px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText("左右拖动看对比", W / 2, H - 106);
            ctx.restore();
            var cb = {
                x: W / 2 - 70,
                y: H - 78,
                w: 140,
                h: 44
            };
            ctx.save();
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.92)";
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, cb.x, cb.y, cb.w, cb.h, 14);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = "#3d4a5c";
            ctx.font = "600 15px " + FONT;
            ctx.textAlign = "center";
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            ctx.fillText("关闭", W / 2, cb.y + cb.h / 2);
            ctx.restore();
            buttons.push({
                x: cb.x,
                y: cb.y,
                w: cb.w,
                h: cb.h,
                onClick: closeCompare
            });
        }
        function openCompare() {
            state = "compare";
            compareSplit = 0.5;
        }
        function closeCompare() {
            state = "done";
        }
        /* ---- 好友排行（微信开放数据域） ---- */ var rankCanvas = null;
        function openRank() {
            state = "rank";
            try {
                if (typeof wx !== "undefined") {
                    if (wx.getSharedCanvas) rankCanvas = wx.getSharedCanvas();
                    if (wx.getOpenDataContext) {
                        wx.getOpenDataContext().postMessage({
                            type: "rank:show"
                        });
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {
                rankCanvas = null;
            }
        }
        function closeRank() {
            try {
                if (typeof wx !== "undefined" && wx.getOpenDataContext) {
                    wx.getOpenDataContext().postMessage({
                        type: "rank:hide"
                    });
                }
            } catch (e) {}
            state = "done";
        }
        function drawRank() {
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,22,34,0.55)";
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
            var availW = W - 36;
            var availH = H - 190;
            var cw = availW, chh = availH;
            var cx = (W - cw) / 2;
            var cy = (H - chh) / 2 - 18;
            var hasData = rankCanvas && rankCanvas.width > 0;
            if (hasData) {
                var sc = Math.min(availW / rankCanvas.width, availH / rankCanvas.height);
                var dw = rankCanvas.width * sc;
                var dh = rankCanvas.height * sc;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(10,26,40,0.35)";
                ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
                ctx.shadowOffsetY = 12;
                ctx.fillStyle = "#f7fbff";
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, (W - dw) / 2, (H - dh) / 2 - 18, dw, dh, 26);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.restore();
                ctx.drawImage(rankCanvas, (W - dw) / 2, (H - dh) / 2 - 18, dw, dh);
            } else {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, cx, cy, cw, chh, 24);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.textAlign = "center";
                ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
                ctx.fillStyle = "#1d2b3a";
                ctx.font = "700 19px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillText("好友排行", W / 2, cy + 56);
                ctx.fillStyle = "#8aa0b4";
                ctx.font = "500 13px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillText("需要在微信小游戏里查看", W / 2, cy + 96);
                ctx.fillText("浏览器预览没有开放数据域", W / 2, cy + 120);
                ctx.restore();
            }
            // 关闭
            var cb = {
                x: W / 2 - 72,
                y: H - 92,
                w: 144,
                h: 48
            };
            ctx.save();
            ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.22)";
            ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
            ctx.shadowOffsetY = 6;
            ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, cb.x, cb.y, cb.w, cb.h, 16);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
            ctx.fillStyle = "#3d4a5c";
            ctx.font = "700 15px " + FONT;
            ctx.textAlign = "center";
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            ctx.fillText("关闭", W / 2, cb.y + cb.h / 2);
            buttons.push({
                x: cb.x,
                y: cb.y,
                w: cb.w,
                h: cb.h,
                onClick: closeRank
            });
        }
        /* ---- 选车 ---- */ function drawPick() {
            var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
            g.addColorStop(0, "#22323f");
            g.addColorStop(1, "#0f1820");
            ctx.fillStyle = g;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
            ctx.save();
            ctx.textAlign = "center";
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.45)";
            ctx.font = "500 12px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText(order.name + " \xb7 还剩 " + pickOptions.length + " 辆", W / 2, 58);
            ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
            ctx.font = "700 23px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText("先洗哪辆？", W / 2, 94);
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.62)";
            ctx.font = "500 13px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText("水箱共用 \xb7 洗完一辆回补 15%", W / 2, 122);
            ctx.restore();
            var cardW = Math.min(W - 44, 366);
            var cardH = 168, gap = 14;
            var n = pickOptions.length;
            var totalH = n * cardH + (n - 1) * gap;
            var y0 = 168 + Math.max(0, (H - 250 - totalH) / 2);
            var cx = (W - cardW) / 2;
            for(var i = 0; i < n; i++){
                var idx = pickOptions[i];
                var lv = NS.LEVEL_INDEX[order.fleet[idx]];
                if (!lv) continue;
                var cy = y0 + i * (cardH + gap);
                ctx.save();
                ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
                ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
                ctx.shadowOffsetY = 8;
                ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, cx, cy, cardW, cardH, 20);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.restore();
                var th = thumbs[idx];
                if (th) {
                    var maxW = cardW - 36, maxH = 92;
                    var sc = Math.min(maxW / th.w, maxH / th.h);
                    var dw = th.w * sc, dh = th.h * sc;
                    ctx.drawImage(th.cv, cx + (cardW - dw) / 2, cy + 16 + (maxH - dh) / 2, dw, dh);
                }
                ctx.save();
                ctx.textAlign = "center";
                ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
                ctx.fillStyle = "#1d2b3a";
                ctx.font = "600 17px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillText(lv.name, cx + cardW / 2, cy + 126);
                var chips = [
                    "软泥"
                ];
                if (lv.heavy) chips.push("厚泥");
                if (lv.grease && lv.grease.length) chips.push("硬垢\xd7" + lv.grease.length);
                if (lv.paint && lv.paint.length) chips.push("漆损\xd7" + lv.paint.length);
                ctx.font = "500 11px " + FONT;
                var widths = [], totalChip = 0, c;
                for(c = 0; c < chips.length; c++){
                    var cw = ctx.measureText(chips[c]).width + 16;
                    widths.push(cw);
                    totalChip += cw + 6;
                }
                totalChip -= 6;
                var chipX = cx + (cardW - totalChip) / 2;
                for(c = 0; c < chips.length; c++){
                    ctx.fillStyle = "#eef3f7";
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    rr(ctx, chipX, cy + 140, widths[c], 18, 9);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a6b7c";
                    ctx.fillText(chips[c], chipX + widths[c] / 2, cy + 150);
                    chipX += widths[c] + 6;
                }
                ctx.restore();
                buttons.push({
                    x: cx,
                    y: cy,
                    w: cardW,
                    h: cardH,
                    onClick: function(id) {
                        return function() {
                            choosePart(id);
                        };
                    }(idx)
                });
            }
        }
        function upgradeLayout() {
            var cw = Math.min(W - 32, 366);
            var rowH = 128, headH = 92, footH = 58;
            var chh = headH + rowH * UPGRADES.length + footH;
            var cx = (W - cw) / 2;
            var cy = (H - chh) / 2;
            var rows = [];
            for(var i = 0; i < UPGRADES.length; i++){
                var ry = cy + headH + i * rowH;
                rows.push({
                    i: i,
                    x: cx,
                    y: ry,
                    w: cw,
                    h: rowH,
                    btn: {
                        x: cx + 16,
                        y: ry + 80,
                        w: cw - 32,
                        h: 36
                    }
                });
            }
            return {
                x: cx,
                y: cy,
                w: cw,
                h: chh,
                rows: rows,
                close: {
                    x: cx + 16,
                    y: cy + chh - footH + 8,
                    w: cw - 32,
                    h: 38
                }
            };
        }
        function drawUpgrade() {
            var L = upgradeLayout();
            ctx.save();
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(10,22,34,0.58)";
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
            ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.28)";
            ctx.shadowBlur = 26;
            ctx.shadowOffsetY = 12;
            ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, L.x, L.y, L.w, L.h, 22);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.shadowColor = "transparent";
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;
            ctx.textAlign = "left";
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            ctx.fillStyle = "#182a3a";
            ctx.font = "700 20px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText("升级水枪", L.x + 22, L.y + 34);
            ctx.textAlign = "right";
            ctx.fillStyle = "#e0a12a";
            ctx.font = "700 17px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText("\uD83D\uDCB0 " + save.coins, L.x + L.w - 22, L.y + 34);
            ctx.textAlign = "left";
            ctx.fillStyle = "#9aa8b6";
            ctx.font = "500 12px " + FONT;
            ctx.fillText("通关赚金币，洗得干净又快给得多", L.x + 22, L.y + 62);
            buttons = [];
            for(var i = 0; i < UPGRADES.length; i++){
                var up = UPGRADES[i];
                var row = L.rows[i];
                var lv = save.up[up.key];
                var full = lv >= up.max;
                var cost = full ? 0 : up.costs[lv - 1];
                var canBuy = !full && save.coins >= cost;
                if (i > 0) {
                    ctx.strokeStyle = "#eef2f6";
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(row.x + 20, row.y);
                    ctx.lineTo(row.x + row.w - 20, row.y);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
                // 购买闪光
                if (buyRow === i && buyFlash > 0) {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.globalAlpha = buyFlash * 0.5;
                    ctx.fillStyle = "#b8f5dd";
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    rr(ctx, row.x + 6, row.y + 4, row.w - 12, row.h - 8, 14);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.restore();
                }
                ctx.textAlign = "left";
                ctx.font = "20px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillText(up.icon, row.x + 22, row.y + 32);
                ctx.fillStyle = "#1d2b3a";
                ctx.font = "600 16px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillText(up.name, row.x + 54, row.y + 30);
                // 等级点
                for(var d = 0; d < up.max; d++){
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(row.x + 54 + 14 + d * 15, row.y + 47, 4.5, 0, TAU);
                    ctx.fillStyle = d < lv ? "#24b98a" : "#e2e8ef";
                    ctx.fill();
                }
                ctx.fillStyle = "#8a99a8";
                ctx.font = "500 12px " + FONT;
                ctx.fillText(full ? up.effect(lv) : up.effect(lv) + "   " + up.next(lv), row.x + 54, row.y + 66);
                // 按钮
                var b = row.btn;
                var label, bg, fg;
                if (full) {
                    label = "已满级";
                    bg = "#eef2f6";
                    fg = "#9aa8b6";
                } else if (canBuy) {
                    label = "升级 \xb7 \uD83D\uDCB0" + cost;
                    bg = "#24b98a";
                    fg = "#ffffff";
                } else {
                    label = "金币不足 \xb7 还差 " + (cost - save.coins);
                    bg = "#eef2f6";
                    fg = "#a8b4c0";
                }
                ctx.fillStyle = bg;
                ctx.beginPath();
                rr(ctx, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 11);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.fillStyle = fg;
                ctx.font = "600 14px " + FONT;
                ctx.textAlign = "center";
                ctx.fillText(label, b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2);
                if (canBuy) {
                    buttons.push({
                        x: b.x,
                        y: b.y,
                        w: b.w,
                        h: b.h,
                        onClick: function(key, idx, price) {
                            return function() {
                                buyUpgrade(key, idx, price);
                            };
                        }(up.key, i, cost)
                    });
                }
            }
            // 关闭
            var cb = L.close;
            ctx.strokeStyle = "#d3dce6";
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            rr(ctx, cb.x, cb.y, cb.w, cb.h, 12);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = "#5b6c7d";
            ctx.font = "600 15px " + FONT;
            ctx.textAlign = "center";
            ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
            ctx.fillText("完成", cb.x + cb.w / 2, cb.y + cb.h / 2);
            buttons.push({
                x: cb.x,
                y: cb.y,
                w: cb.w,
                h: cb.h,
                onClick: closeUpgrade
            });
            ctx.restore();
        }
        function buyUpgrade(key, idx, price) {
            if (save.coins < price) return;
            if (save.up[key] >= 5) return;
            save.coins -= price;
            save.up[key] += 1;
            persist();
            buyRow = idx;
            buyFlash = 1;
            blip(880);
            blip(1180);
            vibrate(12);
        }
        function openUpgrade() {
            if (state !== "done") return;
            state = "upgrade";
        }
        function closeUpgrade() {
            state = "done";
        }
        function restartLevel() {
            startOrder(order);
        }
        function render() {
            buttons = [];
            if (state === "compare") {
                drawCompare();
                return;
            }
            if (state === "pick") {
                drawPick();
                return;
            }
            if (state === "rank") {
                drawScene();
                drawGrade();
                drawRank();
                return;
            }
            drawScene();
            drawToolHighlight();
            drawFoam();
            drawShine();
            drawWater();
            drawParts();
            drawGroundGrass();
            drawForeground();
            drawGrade();
            drawHUD();
            if (state === "done") drawDone();
            if (state === "upgrade") drawUpgrade();
        }
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
   * 11. 输入
   * ------------------------------------------------------------- */ function toLocal(e) {
            var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
            return {
                x: (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * W,
                y: (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height * H
            };
        }
        function hit(p, b) {
            return p.x >= b.x && p.x <= b.x + b.w && p.y >= b.y && p.y <= b.y + b.h;
        }
        cv.addEventListener("pointerdown", function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            initAudio();
            var p = toLocal(e);
            if (state === "rank") {
                for(var ri = 0; ri < buttons.length; ri++){
                    if (hit(p, buttons[ri])) {
                        buttons[ri].onClick();
                        return;
                    }
                }
                return;
            }
            if (state === "pick") {
                for(var ki = 0; ki < buttons.length; ki++){
                    if (hit(p, buttons[ki])) {
                        buttons[ki].onClick();
                        return;
                    }
                }
                return;
            }
            if (state === "compare") {
                for(var ci = 0; ci < buttons.length; ci++){
                    if (hit(p, buttons[ci])) {
                        buttons[ci].onClick();
                        return;
                    }
                }
                compareDrag = true;
                compareSplit = clamp(p.x / W, 0.03, 0.97);
                return;
            }
            if (state === "done" || state === "upgrade") {
                for(var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++){
                    if (hit(p, buttons[i])) {
                        buttons[i].onClick();
                        return;
                    }
                }
                if (state === "upgrade") {
                    var L = upgradeLayout();
                    if (!hit(p, {
                        x: L.x,
                        y: L.y,
                        w: L.w,
                        h: L.h
                    })) closeUpgrade();
                }
                return;
            }
            // 玩的时候先看有没有点中按钮（收工）
            for(var j = 0; j < buttons.length; j++){
                if (hit(p, buttons[j])) {
                    buttons[j].onClick();
                    return;
                }
            }
            pointer.x = p.x;
            pointer.y = p.y;
            lastX = p.x;
            lastY = p.y;
            pointer.down = true;
            try {
                if (cv.setPointerCapture) cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
            } catch (err) {}
            setWater(false);
        });
        cv.addEventListener("pointermove", function(e) {
            if (compareDrag) {
                var cp = toLocal(e);
                compareSplit = clamp(cp.x / W, 0.03, 0.97);
                return;
            }
            if (!pointer.down) return;
            var p = toLocal(e);
            pointer.x = p.x;
            pointer.y = p.y;
        });
        function pointerUp() {
            compareDrag = false;
            pointer.down = false;
            setWater(false);
        }
        cv.addEventListener("pointerup", pointerUp);
        cv.addEventListener("pointercancel", pointerUp);
        cv.addEventListener("pointerleave", pointerUp);
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function() {
            if (document.hidden) {
                pointer.down = false;
                setWater(false);
            }
        });
        window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
            clearTimeout(window.__rz);
            window.__rz = setTimeout(resize, 160);
        });
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------
   * 12. 主循环
   * ------------------------------------------------------------- */ var lastT = 0;
        var frameCount = 0, lastErr = "";
        function frame(t) {
            frameCount++;
            var dt = lastT ? Math.min(0.05, (t - lastT) / 1000) : 0.016;
            lastT = t;
            update(dt);
            render();
            requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }
        // 只在 ?debug=1 时暴露，供截图回归脚本点击按钮
        if (QS.has("debug")) {
            window.__cw = {
                get buttons () {
                    return buttons;
                },
                get state () {
                    return state;
                },
                get save () {
                    return save;
                },
                get water () {
                    return water;
                },
                get waterMax () {
                    return waterMax;
                },
                get waterSpent () {
                    return waterSpent;
                },
                get progress () {
                    return progress;
                },
                get level () {
                    return level;
                },
                get brush () {
                    return brushRadius();
                },
                get tool () {
                    return tool;
                },
                get crusts () {
                    return crustsLeft();
                },
                get paint () {
                    return paintLeft();
                },
                get paintVisible () {
                    return paintShown();
                },
                get playerLevel () {
                    return save.level;
                },
                get xp () {
                    return save.xp;
                },
                get washes () {
                    return save.washes;
                },
                get daily () {
                    return save.daily;
                },
                openRank: openRank,
                openCompare: openCompare,
                startLevel: startLevel,
                openUpgrade: openUpgrade,
                setTool: setTool,
                syncRank: syncRank,
                share: shareNow,
                get pointerDown () {
                    return pointer.down;
                },
                get frames () {
                    return frameCount;
                },
                get pointerXY () {
                    return [
                        pointer.x,
                        pointer.y
                    ];
                },
                get crustPos () {
                    var a = [];
                    for(var i = 0; i < grease.length; i++){
                        if (grease[i].hp > 0) a.push({
                            x: grease[i].x,
                            y: grease[i].y,
                            r: grease[i].r
                        });
                    }
                    return a;
                },
                get paintPos () {
                    var a1 = [];
                    for(var i1 = 0; i1 < paintSpots.length; i1++){
                        a1.push({
                            x: paintSpots[i1].x,
                            y: paintSpots[i1].y,
                            r: paintSpots[i1].r,
                            hp: paintSpots[i1].hp,
                            rev: paintSpots[i1].revealed
                        });
                    }
                    return a1;
                },
                get heavy () {
                    return heavyLeftFrac;
                },
                get audio () {
                    return ac ? {
                        state: ac.state,
                        hasWater: !!waterVoice,
                        freq: waterVoice ? Math.round(waterVoice.bp2.frequency.value) : 0,
                        gain: waterVoice ? +waterVoice.body.gain.value.toFixed(4) : 0,
                        churn: waterVoice ? +waterVoice.churn.gain.value.toFixed(3) : 0,
                        on: waterOn
                    } : "none";
                },
                get imgs () {
                    return Object.keys(IMAGES).filter(function(k) {
                        return !!imgOf(k);
                    });
                },
                refill: function refill() {
                    water = waterMax;
                }
            };
        }
        makeGrain();
        setupShare();
        setupRecorder();
        resize();
        startOrder(LEVELS[clamp(levelIndex, 0, LEVELS.length - 1)]);
        loadImages(function() {
            configureLevel();
        });
        requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    })();
})(GameGlobal.__DOC__, GameGlobal.__WIN__);

}));

frameCount"lastErr"frame"dt"update"__cw"brush"crusts"paintVisible"playerLevel"share"pointerDown"frames"	pointerXY"crustPos"paintPos"rev"revealed"audio"ac"hasWater"
waterVoice"freq"bp2"	frequency"gain"churn"waterOn"imgs"filter"refill"	makeGrain*game.js2��/* 亮车计划 · 微信小游戏入口（构建生成，不要手改） */
/* =====================================================================
 * 微信小游戏适配层
 * 把游戏用到的浏览器 API（document / canvas / pointer / storage / audio）
 * 映射到 wx.*。只"补装"当前环境缺失的全局，已有的不动。
 * =================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var info = wx.getSystemInfoSync();
  var SW = info.screenWidth || 375;
  var SH = info.screenHeight || 667;
  var DPR = Math.min(info.pixelRatio || 1, 2);
  var G = (typeof GameGlobal !== 'undefined') ? GameGlobal : this;

  function install(name, value) {
    if (typeof G[name] !== 'undefined') return;
    try { G[name] = value; } catch (e) { /* 只读就算了 */ }
  }

  /* ---------------- 主画布 ---------------- */
  var mainCanvas = wx.createCanvas();
  mainCanvas.width = Math.round(SW * DPR);
  mainCanvas.height = Math.round(SH * DPR);
  mainCanvas.style = { width: SW + 'px', height: SH + 'px' };

  mainCanvas.getBoundingClientRect = function () {
    return { left: 0, top: 0, width: SW, height: SH, right: SW, bottom: SH };
  };

  var stageEl = {
    style: {},
    getBoundingClientRect: function () {
      return { left: 0, top: 0, width: SW, height: SH, right: SW, bottom: SH };
    }
  };

  /* ---------------- 触摸 → pointer ---------------- */
  var handlers = { down: [], move: [], up: [] };

  function emit(kind, e) {
    var t = (e.touches && e.touches[0]) || (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]);
    if (!t) return;
    var ev = {
      clientX: t.clientX,
      clientY: t.clientY,
      pointerId: (t.identifier != null ? t.identifier : 1),
      pointerType: 'touch',
      isPrimary: true,
      preventDefault: function () {},
      stopPropagation: function () {}
    };
    var list = handlers[kind];
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      try { list[i](ev); } catch (err) { /* 单个监听器出错不能拖垮整局 */ }
    }
  }

  wx.onTouchStart(function (e) { emit('down', e); });
  wx.onTouchMove(function (e) { emit('move', e); });
  wx.onTouchEnd(function (e) { emit('up', e); });
  wx.onTouchCancel(function (e) { emit('up', e); });

  // 实例级覆盖：即使底层是 DOM canvas，也走 wx 触摸通道
  mainCanvas.addEventListener = function (type, fn) {
    if (type === 'pointerdown') handlers.down.push(fn);
    else if (type === 'pointermove') handlers.move.push(fn);
    else handlers.up.push(fn);
  };
  mainCanvas.removeEventListener = function () {};
  mainCanvas.setPointerCapture = function () {};
  mainCanvas.releasePointerCapture = function () {};

  /* ---------------- document ---------------- */
  var docEl = {
    hidden: false,
    getElementById: function (id) {
      if (id === 'game') return mainCanvas;
      if (id === 'stage') return stageEl;
      return null;
    },
    createElement: function (tag) {
      if (tag === 'canvas') {
        var c = wx.createCanvas();      // 第二次以后调用拿到的是离屏画布
        c.style = {};
        return c;
      }
      return { style: {}, appendChild: function () {}, setAttribute: function () {} };
    },
    addEventListener: function (type, fn) {
      if (type === 'visibilitychange') {
        wx.onHide(function () { docEl.hidden = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) {} });
        wx.onShow(function () { docEl.hidden = false; try { fn(); } catch (e) {} });
      }
    },
    removeEventListener: function () {},
    body: { style: {}, appendChild: function () {} }
  };

  /* ---------------- 全局 ---------------- */
  install('document', docEl);
  install('location', { search: '', href: 'minigame:///', origin: '' });
  install('innerWidth', SW);
  install('innerHeight', SH);
  install('devicePixelRatio', DPR);
  install('addEventListener', function () {});
  install('removeEventListener', function () {});

  /* ---------------- 存储 ---------------- */
  install('localStorage', {
    getItem: function (k) {
      try {
        var v = wx.getStorageSync(k);
        return (v === '' || v === undefined || v === null) ? null : v;
      } catch (e) { return null; }
    },
    setItem: function (k, v) {
      try { wx.setStorageSync(k, String(v)); } catch (e) {}
    },
    removeItem: function (k) {
      try { wx.removeStorageSync(k); } catch (e) {}
    }
  });

  /* ---------------- 震动 ---------------- */
  function shortVibe(strong) {
    try {
      wx.vibrateShort({ type: strong ? 'medium' : 'light', fail: function () {} });
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  install('navigator', {
    userAgent: 'minigame',
    vibrate: function (pattern) {
      if (typeof pattern === 'number') { shortVibe(pattern > 20); return true; }
      if (Object.prototype.toString.call(pattern) === '[object Array]' && pattern.length) {
        var strong = false, j, t = 0;
        for (j = 1; j < pattern.length; j += 2) if (pattern[j] > 20) strong = true;
        for (j = 1; j < pattern.length && j < 9; j += 2) {
          t += (pattern[j - 1] || 0) + 30;
          (function (delay, st) {
            setTimeout(function () { shortVibe(st); }, delay);
          })(t, strong);
        }
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
  });

  /* ---------------- 时间 / 动画帧 ---------------- */
  if (typeof G.performance === 'undefined') {
    G.performance = { now: function () { return Date.now(); } };
  }
  if (typeof G.requestAnimationFrame === 'undefined') {
    G.requestAnimationFrame = function (cb) {
      return setTimeout(function () { cb(Date.now()); }, 16);
    };
  }
  if (typeof G.URLSearchParams === 'undefined') {
    // 真正解析一遍，别做成永远返回 false 的空壳 —— 否则 ?debug / ?mute 全部失效
    G.URLSearchParams = function (search) {
      var map = {};
      var s = String(search == null ? '' : search).replace(/^\?/, '');
      if (s) {
        var parts = s.split('&');
        for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
          if (!parts[i]) continue;
          var kv = parts[i].split('=');
          var k = decodeURIComponent(kv[0] || '');
          var v = decodeURIComponent(kv.slice(1).join('=') || '');
          map[k] = v;
        }
      }
      this.has = function (k) { return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, k); };
      this.get = function (k) { return this.has(k) ? map[k] : null; };
      this.append = function (k, v) { map[k] = String(v); };
    };
  }

  /* ---------------- 图片 ---------------- */
  // 游戏里的 loadImages 已被构建脚本改写成 wx.createImage()
  install('Image', function () { return wx.createImage(); });

  /* ---------------- 音频 ---------------- */
  // 小游戏基础库 2.19.0+ 才有 WebAudio；不支持时游戏自动静音
  try {
    if (typeof G.AudioContext === 'undefined' && wx.createWebAudioContext) {
      G.AudioContext = function () { return wx.createWebAudioContext(); };
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  /* ---------------- 刘海屏安全区 ---------------- */
  try {
    G.__SAFE_TOP = (info.safeArea && info.safeArea.top) || info.statusBarHeight || 0;
  } catch (e) { G.__SAFE_TOP = 0; }

  /* ---------------- 导出给入口包装函数 ---------------- */
  // 小游戏全局里可能已有一个残缺的 document（没有 getElementById），
  // 所以不依赖全局解析，改为由构建时包一层函数把这两个对象注入进去。
  try {
    G.__DOC__ = docEl;
    G.__WIN__ = G;
  } catch (e) {}

  /* ---------------- 调试信息 ---------------- */
  try {
    G.__WX_ENV = {
      screenWidth: SW,
      screenHeight: SH,
      pixelRatio: DPR,
      safeArea: info.safeArea || null,
      statusBarHeight: info.statusBarHeight || 0
    };
  } catch (e) {}
})();


(function (document, window) {

/* 素材映射（构建生成） */
window.CW_IMG = {
  bg_dawn: "images/bg_dawn.webp",
  bg_dusk: "images/bg_dusk.webp",
  bg_outdoor: "images/bg_outdoor.webp",
  brick_wall: "images/brick_wall.webp",
  car_black: "images/car_black.webp",
  car_coupe: "images/car_coupe.webp",
  car_jeep: "images/car_jeep.webp",
  car_sedan: "images/car_sedan.webp",
  car_truck: "images/car_truck.webp",
  car_van: "images/car_van.webp",
  dirt_heavy: "images/dirt_heavy.webp",
  dirt_soft: "images/dirt_soft.webp",
  fx_foam: "images/fx_foam.webp",
  fx_splash: "images/fx_splash.webp",
  grime_hard: "images/grime_hard.webp",
  hub: "images/hub.webp",
  paint_damage: "images/paint_damage.webp",
  vase: "images/vase.webp",
  window: "images/window.webp",
};


/* =====================================================================
 * 关卡数据 + 升级表
 * 每个关卡 = 一个剪影 + 一个绘制函数 + 一组污渍配方
 * 换新关卡只需要在这里加一坨数据
 * =================================================================== */
(function (root) {
  'use strict';
  var NS = root.CW = root.CW || {};
  var TAU = Math.PI * 2;

  /* ---------- 画布小工具 ---------- */
  function rr(c, x, y, w, h, r) {
    r = Math.max(0, Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2));
    c.moveTo(x + r, y);
    c.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    c.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    c.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    c.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    c.closePath();
  }

  function polyPath(c, pts) {
    c.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
    for (var i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) c.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
    c.closePath();
  }

  function mapPts(pts, x, y, w, h) {
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) out.push([x + w * pts[i][0], y + h * pts[i][1]]);
    return out;
  }

  function polyBBox(pts) {
    var x0 = 1e9, y0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y1 = -1e9;
    for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
      x0 = Math.min(x0, pts[i][0]); x1 = Math.max(x1, pts[i][0]);
      y0 = Math.min(y0, pts[i][1]); y1 = Math.max(y1, pts[i][1]);
    }
    return { x0: x0, y0: y0, x1: x1, y1: y1 };
  }

  /** 朝中心收缩，用来从车厢轮廓得到玻璃轮廓 */
  function insetPoly(pts, kx, ky) {
    var b = polyBBox(pts);
    var cx = (b.x0 + b.x1) / 2, cy = (b.y0 + b.y1) / 2;
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
      out.push([cx + (pts[i][0] - cx) * kx, cy + (pts[i][1] - cy) * ky]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  function lighten(hex, k) {
    var n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
    var r = Math.min(255, Math.round(((n >> 16) & 255) * k));
    var g = Math.min(255, Math.round(((n >> 8) & 255) * k));
    var b = Math.min(255, Math.round((n & 255) * k));
    return 'rgb(' + r + ',' + g + ',' + b + ')';
  }

  /* ---------- 车辆：一套参数画所有车 ---------- */
  function vehicleSilhouette(c, b, s) {
    var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h;
    rr(c, x, y + h * s.bodyTop, w, h * (s.bodyBottom - s.bodyTop), h * s.bodyR);
    polyPath(c, mapPts(s.cabin, x, y, w, h));
    for (var i = 0; i < s.wheels.length; i++) {
      var cx = x + w * s.wheels[i], cy = y + h * (1 - s.wheelR), rad = h * s.wheelR;
      c.moveTo(cx + rad, cy);
      c.arc(cx, cy, rad, 0, TAU);
    }
  }

  function vehiclePaint(c, b, s) {
    var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h, i;
    var bt = y + h * s.bodyTop, bb = y + h * s.bodyBottom, bh = bb - bt;

    // 接地阴影：用径向渐变，比一块平椭圆柔和很多
    c.save();
    var sh = c.createRadialGradient(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99, 0, x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99, w * 0.52);
    sh.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(16,38,26,0.30)');
    sh.addColorStop(0.62, 'rgba(16,38,26,0.14)');
    sh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(16,38,26,0)');
    c.fillStyle = sh;
    c.beginPath();
    c.ellipse(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99, w * 0.52, h * 0.085, 0, 0, TAU);
    c.fill();
    c.restore();

    for (i = 0; i < s.wheels.length; i++) {
      var cx = x + w * s.wheels[i], cy = y + h - h * s.wheelR, rad = h * s.wheelR;
      c.beginPath(); c.arc(cx, cy, rad, 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = '#2a2f37'; c.fill();
      // 胎侧高光
      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)';
      c.lineWidth = rad * 0.16;
      c.beginPath();
      c.arc(cx, cy, rad * 0.84, Math.PI * 1.12, Math.PI * 1.72);
      c.stroke();
      c.beginPath(); c.arc(cx, cy, rad * 0.46, 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = '#cfd9e4'; c.fill();
      c.beginPath(); c.arc(cx, cy, rad * 0.16, 0, TAU); c.fillStyle = '#95a3b1'; c.fill();
    }

    var g = c.createLinearGradient(0, bt, 0, bb);
    g.addColorStop(0, lighten(s.color, 1.14));
    g.addColorStop(0.45, s.color);
    g.addColorStop(1, s.color2);
    c.beginPath(); rr(c, x, bt, w, bh, h * s.bodyR);
    c.fillStyle = g; c.fill();

    // 车身上沿的高光带：一下就有"车漆"的质感
    c.save();
    c.beginPath(); rr(c, x, bt, w, bh, h * s.bodyR); c.clip();
    var hl = c.createLinearGradient(0, bt, 0, bt + bh * 0.34);
    hl.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.40)');
    hl.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    c.fillStyle = hl;
    c.fillRect(x, bt, w, bh * 0.34);
    c.restore();

    var cabPts = mapPts(s.cabin, x, y, w, h);
    c.beginPath(); polyPath(c, cabPts);
    var g2 = c.createLinearGradient(0, y + h * s.bodyTop * 0.1, 0, bt);
    g2.addColorStop(0, lighten(s.color, 1.08));
    g2.addColorStop(1, s.color);
    c.fillStyle = g2; c.fill();

    var glassN = insetPoly(s.cabin, 0.93, 0.74);
    var glassPts = mapPts(glassN, x, y, w, h);
    var gb = polyBBox(glassN);
    c.beginPath(); polyPath(c, glassPts);
    var gg = c.createLinearGradient(0, y + h * gb.y0, 0, y + h * gb.y1);
    gg.addColorStop(0, '#D9EEFF');
    gg.addColorStop(0.5, '#A6CDF0');
    gg.addColorStop(1, '#7FB3E2');
    c.fillStyle = gg; c.fill();

    c.save();
    c.beginPath(); polyPath(c, glassPts); c.clip();
    c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.30)';
    c.lineWidth = h * 0.022;
    c.beginPath();
    c.moveTo(x + w * 0.32, y + h * (gb.y1 + 0.01));
    c.lineTo(x + w * 0.38, y + h * (gb.y0 - 0.01));
    c.stroke();
    c.beginPath();
    c.moveTo(x + w * 0.60, y + h * (gb.y1 + 0.01));
    c.lineTo(x + w * 0.66, y + h * (gb.y0 - 0.01));
    c.stroke();
    c.restore();

    var pil = s.pillars || [];
    for (i = 0; i < pil.length; i++) {
      var px = x + w * (gb.x0 + (gb.x1 - gb.x0) * pil[i]);
      c.fillStyle = s.color2;
      c.fillRect(px - w * 0.017, y + h * gb.y0, w * 0.034, h * (gb.y1 - gb.y0));
    }

    if (s.headlight !== false) {
      c.beginPath();
      rr(c, x + w * 0.895, bt + bh * 0.28, w * 0.055, bh * 0.26, h * 0.025);
      c.fillStyle = '#ffeec2'; c.fill();
    }

    if (s.stripe) {
      c.save();
      c.beginPath(); rr(c, x, bt, w, bh, h * s.bodyR); c.clip();
      c.fillStyle = s.stripe;
      c.fillRect(x, bt + bh * 0.52, w, bh * 0.16);
      c.restore();
    }

    if (s.line !== false) {
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(x + w * 0.06, bt + bh * 0.66);
      c.lineTo(x + w * 0.94, bt + bh * 0.66);
      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.32)';
      c.lineWidth = Math.max(1, h * 0.012);
      c.stroke();
    }

    c.save();
    c.beginPath(); rr(c, x, bt, w, bh, h * s.bodyR); c.clip();
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.13)';
    c.fillRect(x, bb - bh * 0.16, w, bh * 0.16);
    c.restore();

    if (s.rack) {
      c.strokeStyle = '#3d4652';
      c.lineWidth = Math.max(2, h * 0.018);
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(x + w * 0.22, y + h * 0.035);
      c.lineTo(x + w * 0.74, y + h * 0.035);
      c.stroke();
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(x + w * 0.30, y + h * 0.035);
      c.lineTo(x + w * 0.30, y + h * 0.075);
      c.moveTo(x + w * 0.66, y + h * 0.035);
      c.lineTo(x + w * 0.66, y + h * 0.075);
      c.stroke();
    }
  }

  function vehicle(s) {
    return {
      silhouette: function (c, b) { vehicleSilhouette(c, b, s); },
      paint: function (c, b) { vehiclePaint(c, b, s); }
    };
  }

  /* ---------- 砖墙 ---------- */
  function brickWall() {
    return {
      silhouette: function (c, b) { rr(c, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 8); },
      paint: function (c, b) {
        var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h;
        c.save();
        c.beginPath(); rr(c, x, y, w, h, 8); c.clip();
        c.fillStyle = '#efe0c8';
        c.fillRect(x, y, w, h);

        var rows = 8, cols = 5;
        var bh = h / rows, bw = w / cols;
        for (var r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
          var off = (r % 2) ? -bw / 2 : 0;
          for (var i = -1; i <= cols; i++) {
            var bx = x + i * bw + off + 2;
            var by = y + r * bh + 2;
            var v = 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.1;
            c.fillStyle = 'rgb(' + ((212 * v) | 0) + ',' + ((178 * v) | 0) + ',' + ((146 * v) | 0) + ')';
            c.beginPath(); rr(c, bx, by, bw - 4, bh - 4, 3); c.fill();
          }
        }
        c.restore();

        c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,118,88,0.55)';
        c.lineWidth = 2;
        c.beginPath(); rr(c, x, y, w, h, 8); c.stroke();
      }
    };
  }

  /* ---------- 陶罐 ---------- */
  var VASE = {
    silhouette: function (c, b) {
      var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h;
      c.moveTo(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.16);
      c.bezierCurveTo(x - w * 0.05, y + h * 0.26, x + w * 0.02, y + h * 0.92, x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99);
      c.bezierCurveTo(x + w * 0.98, y + h * 0.92, x + w * 1.05, y + h * 0.26, x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.16);
      c.closePath();
      c.moveTo(x + w * 0.33, y + h * 0.055);
      c.lineTo(x + w * 0.67, y + h * 0.055);
      c.lineTo(x + w * 0.60, y + h * 0.20);
      c.lineTo(x + w * 0.40, y + h * 0.20);
      c.closePath();
    },
    paint: function (c, b) {
      var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h;

      c.save();
      c.globalAlpha = 0.15;
      c.fillStyle = '#1d3346';
      c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99, w * 0.38, h * 0.04, 0, 0, TAU); c.fill();
      c.restore();

      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.16);
      c.bezierCurveTo(x - w * 0.05, y + h * 0.26, x + w * 0.02, y + h * 0.92, x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.99);
      c.bezierCurveTo(x + w * 0.98, y + h * 0.92, x + w * 1.05, y + h * 0.26, x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.16);
      c.closePath();
      var g = c.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x + w, 0);
      g.addColorStop(0, '#2b8492');
      g.addColorStop(0.32, '#5cbfcb');
      g.addColorStop(0.58, '#8adde2');
      g.addColorStop(1, '#26707e');
      c.fillStyle = g; c.fill();

      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(x + w * 0.33, y + h * 0.055);
      c.lineTo(x + w * 0.67, y + h * 0.055);
      c.lineTo(x + w * 0.60, y + h * 0.20);
      c.lineTo(x + w * 0.40, y + h * 0.20);
      c.closePath();
      c.fillStyle = '#3f9dab'; c.fill();

      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.055, w * 0.17, h * 0.02, 0, 0, TAU);
      c.fillStyle = '#96e6e8'; c.fill();

      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
      c.lineWidth = Math.max(2, h * 0.012);
      c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.56, w * 0.30, h * 0.04, 0, 0, Math.PI); c.stroke();
      c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.72, w * 0.24, h * 0.03, 0, 0, Math.PI); c.stroke();

      c.save();
      c.globalAlpha = 0.35;
      c.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(x + w * 0.34, y + h * 0.46, w * 0.05, h * 0.15, -0.2, 0, TAU); c.fill();
      c.restore();
    }
  };

  /* ---------- 老窗户 ---------- */
  var WINDOW = {
    silhouette: function (c, b) { rr(c, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 6); },
    paint: function (c, b) {
      var x = b.x, y = b.y, w = b.w, h = b.h;
      var fr = Math.min(w, h) * 0.07;

      c.beginPath(); rr(c, x, y, w, h, 6);
      c.fillStyle = '#8d6e4e'; c.fill();

      var gx = x + fr, gy = y + fr, gw = w - fr * 2, gh = h - fr * 2;
      var g = c.createLinearGradient(gx, gy, gx + gw, gy + gh);
      g.addColorStop(0, '#cfe9ff');
      g.addColorStop(0.5, '#a9d3f0');
      g.addColorStop(1, '#8bbde4');
      c.fillStyle = g;
      c.fillRect(gx, gy, gw, gh);

      c.fillStyle = '#8d6e4e';
      c.fillRect(x + w * 0.5 - fr * 0.32, gy, fr * 0.64, gh);
      c.fillRect(gx, y + h * 0.44 - fr * 0.32, gw, fr * 0.64);

      c.save();
      c.beginPath(); c.rect(gx, gy, gw, gh); c.clip();
      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
      c.lineWidth = fr * 0.5;
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(gx + gw * 0.15, gy + gh);
      c.lineTo(gx + gw * 0.45, gy);
      c.stroke();
      c.restore();

      c.fillStyle = '#77593c';
      c.fillRect(x - w * 0.04, y + h, w * 1.08, Math.max(6, h * 0.05));
    }
  };

  /* ---------- 轮毂 ---------- */
  var HUB = {
    silhouette: function (c, b) {
      var r = Math.min(b.w, b.h) * 0.5;
      var cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
      c.moveTo(cx + r, cy);
      c.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, TAU);
    },
    paint: function (c, b) {
      var r = Math.min(b.w, b.h) * 0.5;
      var cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
      var i;

      c.beginPath(); c.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, TAU);
      c.fillStyle = '#2a2f37'; c.fill();

      c.strokeStyle = '#3d434e';
      c.lineWidth = r * 0.03;
      for (i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
        var a = i / 28 * TAU;
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.86, cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.86);
        c.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.96, cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.96);
        c.stroke();
      }

      c.beginPath(); c.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.72, 0, TAU);
      c.fillStyle = '#cfd9e4'; c.fill();

      c.save();
      c.fillStyle = '#aab6c4';
      for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        var ang = i / 5 * TAU - Math.PI / 2;
        c.save();
        c.translate(cx, cy);
        c.rotate(ang);
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(-r * 0.10, -r * 0.22);
        c.lineTo(r * 0.10, -r * 0.22);
        c.lineTo(r * 0.16, -r * 0.68);
        c.lineTo(-r * 0.16, -r * 0.68);
        c.closePath();
        c.fill();
        c.restore();
      }
      c.restore();

      c.beginPath(); c.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.26, 0, TAU);
      c.fillStyle = '#8b98a8'; c.fill();
      c.beginPath(); c.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.12, 0, TAU);
      c.fillStyle = '#cfd9e4'; c.fill();

      c.fillStyle = '#6d7a8a';
      for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        var a2 = i / 5 * TAU + 0.3;
        c.beginPath();
        c.arc(cx + Math.cos(a2) * r * 0.19, cy + Math.sin(a2) * r * 0.19, r * 0.045, 0, TAU);
        c.fill();
      }
    }
  };
